01

学习目标与阅读路线Learning objectives and reading route

MSLFaults 在与 Modelica Standard Library 元件对应的结构中提供可选择故障模式的实现。它的主要使用方式是：保留本体的连接与名义参数，只把一个选定元件替换为故障化版本，然后比较无故障、激活、恢复三个阶段。MSLFaults supplies selectable fault mechanisms in a structure corresponding to Modelica Standard Library components. Its principal workflow preserves host connections and nominal parameters, replaces a selected component, and compares nominal, activated and recovered behaviour.

本指南覆盖电气、转动和平动机械、磁路、热、流体和信号环节。学习时应先比较 MSL 原生元件与 FaultMode.Normal，再研究某一个故障模式，而不是把整个库一次性用于未经检查的复杂本体。This guide covers electrical, rotational and translational mechanical, magnetic, thermal, fluid and signal components. First compare the native MSL component with FaultMode.Normal, then study one fault mode; do not introduce the entire library into an unchecked complex plant at once.

本指南依据固定提交的源码编写。示例中的数值与曲线描述为源码推导的复现参考，未在本次文档工作中重新运行 Modelica 仿真。This guide documents a fixed source revision. Numerical and curve descriptions are source-derived reproduction references; Modelica simulations were not re-run during this documentation work.
阶段Stage操作与学习目标Action and learning objective
01用 ResistorReplacement 识别原生、Normal 和故障支路，并读懂激活与恢复。Use ResistorReplacement to identify native, Normal and faulted branches and interpret activation and recovery.
02学习电容与电感案例，区分参数变化、储能变化和耗散。Study capacitor and inductor examples, distinguishing parameter variation, stored energy and dissipation.
03按自己的物理域选择机械、热、磁路或流体案例，先做解析数量级核对。Choose a mechanical, thermal, magnetic or fluid example and check analytical orders of magnitude.
04最后研究传感与多域案例，在独立研究包中逐项替换元件并保留对照。Finish with sensing and multi-domain examples, replacing components one at a time in a separate study package.

建议先掌握一个完整示例，再按问题查找元件。每张元件卡列出实际参数和接口，并提供去除图形注解的源码；辅助类与可直接实例化的元件分别列出。Begin with one complete example, then select components by the question being studied. Each component card contains actual parameters, interfaces and source with graphical annotations omitted. Supporting classes are distinguished from directly instantiable components.

02

理解元件之前，先理解这些概念Concepts to understand before using the components

替换是接口与语义的双重约束Replacement constrains both interface and semantics

同名参数或相似图标不保证替换成立。检查物理端口、条件热端口、初始化状态与 nominalCounterpart。若本体使用 replaceable 和 constrainedby，须在目标工具中检查 redeclare 的类型约束；图形上手动替换也要重新核对所有参数。Similar names or icons do not guarantee compatibility. Check physical connectors, conditional thermal ports, initial states and the nominal counterpart. For replaceable components constrained by a native type, check redeclare compatibility in the target tool; manual graphical replacement also requires parameter review.

每个类有自己的 FaultModeEach class declares its own FaultMode

故障模式是局部枚举，必须使用本元件完整类型路径。某个电阻有 OpenCircuit，不表示所有传感器或阀门也有同名模式。下方逐元件列出实际枚举，避免依赖通用名称猜测。Fault modes are local enumerations and must use the component-specific qualified type. An OpenCircuit mode on a resistor does not imply that every sensor or valve declares it. The reference lists each actual enumeration rather than guessing from a universal vocabulary.

请求、效果和永久状态需要分别解释Separate request, effect and retained state

faultStartTime、faultEndTime、transitionTime 与 severity 共同定义故障作用；有些模式捕获历史值，有些改变内部状态或保留不可逆效果。窗口结束不意味着系统一定回到之前轨迹，也不意味着储能被恢复。faultStartTime, faultEndTime, transitionTime and severity jointly define an intervention. Some modes capture historical values; others alter or retain internal state. Closing the fault window does not guarantee a return to the earlier trajectory or restoration of stored energy.

传感器读数不是物理真值A sensor reading is not physical truth

传感故障可能只改变读数，不改变被测支路电流、压力或转速。研究反馈后果时必须让控制器使用故障化读数，同时把本体真值留作独立观察；开环传感案例只展示读数机制。A sensor fault may alter only the reported value, leaving physical current, pressure or speed unchanged. To study feedback consequences, drive the controller from the faulted reading and preserve physical truth independently. An open-loop sensor example demonstrates the reporting mechanism only.

时变储能参数不只有损耗Variable storage parameters involve more than loss

C、L、m、J 或弹簧刚度变化会改变能量表达。若实现提供 storedEnergy、lossPower 或 parameterPower，应分别检查：热耗散与因参数变化交换的功率不能直接混为一谈。有限过渡可以缓和数值突变，但不能替代对故障物理假设的说明。Changes in C, L, m, J or stiffness alter energy relations. Where provided, inspect storedEnergy, lossPower and parameterPower separately: dissipation and power exchanged through parameter changes are different quantities. Finite transitions can moderate discontinuities but do not replace physical justification.

因果信号端口用于传递数值或逻辑；电气、机械、热和流体物理端口参与网络方程。不能把物理端口当作普通输入输出，也不能用一个布尔保护请求代替实际的能量或物质通路。Causal signal connectors convey values or logic. Electrical, mechanical, thermal and fluid connectors participate in network equations. A physical connector is not an ordinary signal input, and a Boolean request does not replace an energy or material path.

功能分区Functional area定义数Definitions什么时候用、怎样接入When and how to use it
Blocks
信号与动态环节Signal and dynamic blocks		4用故障版本替换 Gain、FirstOrder、Limiter 或 FixedDelay；保留原名义增益、时间常数及初始化设置。把输入 u 和输出 y 接入原有信号路径，并检查冻结、固定输出与连续状态冻结的差别。Replace Gain, FirstOrder, Limiter or FixedDelay while preserving nominal gain, time constants and initialisation. Reconnect u and y in the original path and distinguish held inputs, fixed outputs and frozen continuous states.
Electrical.Analog.Basic
电路基础元件Basic circuit components		15保持 p/n 极性与电路参考；按原元件配置 R、G、C、L 或变比。先选 Normal 对照，再选本类 FaultMode；对储能元件同时检查初态、状态变量与参数功率。Preserve p/n orientation and electrical reference, and retain R, G, C, L or transformation ratio. Compare Normal first, then select the local FaultMode. For storage components, inspect initial states, state variables and parameter power.
Electrical.Analog.Ideal
理想器件与有限故障近似Ideal devices and finite fault approximations		13检查开关命令方向、导通电阻、关断电导及放大器输入/输出端口。失效开路或短路通常需要有限参数；不要假设能在任何理想源组合中无条件工作。Check switch-command polarity, on-resistance, off-conductance and amplifier ports. Open/short failures generally require finite parameters; do not assume compatibility with every combination of ideal sources.
Electrical.Analog.Semiconductors
半导体故障机理Semiconductor fault mechanisms		6将器件接入完整偏置回路，核对结参数、端子名称与热边界。先选小型直流或瞬态工况；NPNFaultStage 属于局部机理辅助，不应当作完整独立实验。Connect the device in a complete bias circuit and check junction parameters, terminal names and thermal boundaries. Begin with a small DC or transient experiment. NPNFaultStage supports a local mechanism rather than a complete stand-alone experiment.
Electrical.Analog.Sensors
电气测量故障Electrical sensing faults		5电流类按测量定义串入，电压类跨接被测节点。观察 reported 输出与真实支路量，确认控制器接到需要研究的读数路径，而不是无故障旁路。Insert current sensing and connect voltage sensing according to their measurement definitions. Compare reported and physical quantities and ensure the controller uses the intended measurement path.
Electrical.Analog.Sources
源输出故障Source-output faults		15保留原波形幅值、频率和起始时刻，再设置源本身的幅值、偏置、时序或丢失模式。注意理想源与外部网络之间的约束冲突，必要时建立实际有限阻抗。Retain nominal waveform amplitude, frequency and timing before selecting source amplitude, offset, timing or loss modes. Check ideal-source constraints against the external network and introduce physically justified finite impedance where required.
Mechanics.Rotational
转动元件与传感Rotational components and sensing		20确认 flange_a/flange_b 正方向、支撑端和相对量。惯量、刚度、阻尼、摩擦、齿隙与制动故障作用不同；用转速、相对角、转矩和耗散解释，不要只看一个报警量。Check flange orientation, support and relative quantities. Inertia, stiffness, damping, friction, backlash and braking faults have different effects. Interpret speed, relative angle, torque and dissipation rather than a single alarm.
Mechanics.Translational
平动元件与传感Translational components and sensing		21保留质量、弹簧自由长度、摩擦及限位初始条件，检查运动正方向和参考支撑。质量变化主要影响动态，刚度变化还影响静态位移；须分别做对照。Preserve mass, spring free length, friction and stop initial conditions and check motion direction and support. Mass variation primarily affects dynamics, while stiffness also changes static displacement; compare these separately.
Magnetic.FluxTubes
集总磁路Lumped magnetic circuits		10形成闭合磁路并建立磁势参考，明确磁阻/磁导、漏磁和电磁转换匝数。传感读数故障与磁路机理故障不可互换；有效匝数变化需要检查电侧与磁侧能量关系。Form a closed magnetic circuit with a potential reference and declare reluctance/permeance, leakage and converter turns. Sensor errors and circuit faults are different mechanisms. Check electrical–magnetic energy relations when effective turns vary.
Thermal.HeatTransfer
热容量与传热退化Thermal storage and heat-transfer degradation		9连接热容量、环境及热流边界，使用 K。区分容量变化与传热能力变化：前者改变惯性，后者通常也改变稳态温升。可选热端口必须明确连接。Connect thermal storage, environment and heat-flow boundaries using kelvin. Capacity variation changes thermal inertia; transfer variation generally also changes steady temperature rise. Connect every enabled conditional heat port.
Thermal.FluidHeatFlow
简化热流体网络Simplified thermal-fluid networks		10采用该子库自己的接口、介质参数和参考网络，不要直接与 Modelica.Fluid 的 stream 端口混接。传感输出、管阻和阀动作分别验证。Use this sublibrary’s own interfaces, medium parameters and references; do not directly mix them with Modelica.Fluid stream connectors. Verify sensor output, resistance and valve action separately.
Fluid
流体机件与传感Fluid machinery and sensing		15统一 Medium，配置 inner Modelica.Fluid.System 及足够边界。泵、管、阀的故障要与介质工况一致；检查 flow reversal、初始压力/温度与流出状态，先在单支路验证。Use a consistent Medium, inner Modelica.Fluid.System and sufficient boundaries. Match pump, pipe and valve faults to medium conditions. Check flow reversal, initial pressure/temperature and stream-state semantics in a single branch first.

准备 Modelica Standard Library 4.0.0 和能够加载该版本的 Modelica 工具。保留源码目录结构；打开根目录 package.mo，而不是逐个加载底层 .mo 文件。克隆目录名称宜与根包名称一致。Prepare Modelica Standard Library 4.0.0 and a Modelica tool that can load that version. Preserve the source directory structure and open the root package.mo rather than loading leaf files separately. Prefer a checkout directory named after the root package.

git clone https://github.com/Ruizhe-Yang/MSLFaults.git MSLFaults
cd MSLFaults
git checkout 283f3965f944ef3943e22e8896a2c72dc21017dd

2打开 MSLFaults.Examples.ResistorReplacement，先查看 Diagram 和参数，再进入仿真设置。Open MSLFaults.Examples.ResistorReplacement; inspect the Diagram and parameters before simulation settings.
3采用下方源码声明的实验设置。运行后先检查求解器是否正常终止，不要仅凭出现结果文件判断成功。Use the experiment settings declared below. Check successful solver termination before interpreting any result file.
4绘制示例卡指定的输入、输出及资格状态；在事件前、事件中、事件后分别读值。Plot the input, output and qualification variables listed in the example card; inspect values before, during and after each event.
// Run from the repository root after MSL 4.0.0 is installed.
loadModel(Modelica, {"4.0.0"});
loadFile("package.mo");
getErrorString();
checkModel(MSLFaults.Examples.ResistorReplacement);
simulate(MSLFaults.Examples.ResistorReplacement,
  startTime=0, stopTime=5, numberOfIntervals=1000, tolerance=1e-6);
getErrorString();
脚本将输出网格统一设为 1000 个区间，仅便于第一次观察。元件内部 samplePeriod、通信服务网格或离散事件逻辑不会因此自动改变；后文同时列出各示例原有的 Interval。The script uses 1,000 output intervals for initial inspection. This does not change an internal samplePeriod, communication service grid or discrete-event policy. The original Interval annotation is also shown for each example.

直接引用此类的示例：Examples directly referencing this class: SensorAndSignalFaults

实现与使用契约：阅读本元件源码Implementation and usage contract: inspect the source
within MSLFaults.Blocks.Continuous;
block FaultableFirstOrder "Independent fault-enhanced MSL 4.0.0 FirstOrder"
  import Init=Modelica.Blocks.Types.Init;
  parameter Real k(unit="1")=1 "Gain";
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time T(start=1) "Time constant";
  parameter Init initType=Init.NoInit ;
  parameter Real y_start=0 ;
  extends Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.SISO(y(start=y_start));
  type FaultMode=enumeration(Normal, GainDrift, TimeConstantDrift, Bias, Stuck, Dropout, Freeze "Hold the value captured on activation");
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal;
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultStartTime=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultEndTime=3;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05;
  parameter Real kFault=0.5*k;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time TFault(min=Modelica.Constants.eps)=2*T;
  parameter Real biasFault=1;
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1),startActivation(min=0,max=1),endActivation(min=0,max=1),k_effective;
  Modelica.Units.SI.Time T_effective;
  Real x(start=y_start);

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";
  discrete Real captured(start=0,fixed=true);
protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
initial equation
  if initType==Init.SteadyState then
    der(x)=0;
  elseif initType==Init.InitialState or initType==Init.InitialOutput then
    x=y_start;
  end if;
  assert(T>0 and TFault>0,"First-order time constants must be positive.");
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  k_effective=if faultMode==FaultMode.GainDrift then k+faultActivation*(kFault-k) else k;
  T_effective=if faultMode==FaultMode.TimeConstantDrift then T+faultActivation*(TFault-T) else T;
  der(x)=(if faultMode==FaultMode.Stuck then 1-faultActivation else 1)*(k_effective*u-x)/T_effective;
  y=if faultMode==FaultMode.Freeze then x+faultActivation*(captured-x) else if faultMode==FaultMode.Bias then x+faultActivation*biasFault elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Dropout then (1-faultActivation)*x else x;

  when {initial(),active} then captured=x; end when;
end FaultableFirstOrder;

block FaultableGain "Independent fault-enhanced MSL 4.0.0 Gain"
  parameter Real k(start=1,unit="1") "Gain value multiplied with input signal";
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.RealInput u ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.RealOutput y ;
  type FaultMode=enumeration(Normal, GainDrift, Bias, Stuck, Dropout, Saturation, Freeze "Hold the value captured on activation");
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal;
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultStartTime=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultEndTime=3;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05;
  parameter Real kFault=0.5*k;
  parameter Real biasFault=1;
  parameter Real stuckValue=0;
  parameter Real saturationLimit=1e9;
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1),startActivation(min=0,max=1),endActivation(min=0,max=1),k_effective,y_raw;

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";
  discrete Real captured(start=0,fixed=true);
protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
initial equation
  assert(saturationLimit>=0,"The gain output limit must be nonnegative.");
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  k_effective=if faultMode==FaultMode.GainDrift then k+faultActivation*(kFault-k) else k;
  y_raw=k_effective*u;
  y=if faultMode==FaultMode.Freeze then y_raw+faultActivation*(captured-y_raw) else if faultMode==FaultMode.Bias then y_raw+faultActivation*biasFault elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Stuck then y_raw+faultActivation*(stuckValue-y_raw) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Dropout then (1-faultActivation)*y_raw elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Saturation then y_raw+faultActivation*(min(saturationLimit,max(-saturationLimit,y_raw))-y_raw) else y_raw;

  when {initial(),active} then captured=y_raw; end when;
end FaultableGain;

block FaultableLimiter "Limit the range of a signal"
  parameter Real uMax(start=1) "Upper limits of input signals";
  parameter Real uMin= -uMax "Lower limits of input signals";
  parameter Boolean strict=false "= true, if strict limits with noEvent(..)"
  parameter Modelica.Blocks.Types.LimiterHomotopy homotopyType = Modelica.Blocks.Types.LimiterHomotopy.Linear "Simplified model for homotopy-based initialization"
  extends Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.SISO;
  type FaultMode=enumeration(Normal, UpperLimitDrift, LowerLimitDrift, Stuck);
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal;
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultStartTime=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultEndTime=3;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05;
  parameter Real upperFault=uMax;
  parameter Real lowerFault=uMin;
  parameter Real stuckValue=0;
  Real faultActivation,startActivation,endActivation;
  Real upperEffective,lowerEffective;
  Real limitedValue;
  protected
  Real simplifiedExpr "Simplified expression for homotopy-based initialization";


public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
initial equation
  assert(uMin<=uMax,"Reversed nominal limiter bounds.");
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;
  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;

  faultActivation=effectLevel;

  assert(upperEffective >= lowerEffective, "Limiter: Limits must be consistent. However, upperEffective (=" + String(upperEffective) +
                       ") < lowerEffective (=" + String(lowerEffective) + ")");
  simplifiedExpr = (if homotopyType == Modelica.Blocks.Types.LimiterHomotopy.Linear then u
                    else if homotopyType == Modelica.Blocks.Types.LimiterHomotopy.UpperLimit then upperEffective
                    else if homotopyType == Modelica.Blocks.Types.LimiterHomotopy.LowerLimit then lowerEffective
                    else 0);
  if strict then
    if homotopyType == Modelica.Blocks.Types.LimiterHomotopy.NoHomotopy then
      limitedValue = smooth(0, noEvent(if u > upperEffective then upperEffective else if u < lowerEffective then lowerEffective else u));
    else
      limitedValue = homotopy(actual = smooth(0, noEvent(if u > upperEffective then upperEffective else if u < lowerEffective then lowerEffective else u)),
                   simplified=simplifiedExpr);
    end if;
  else
    if homotopyType == Modelica.Blocks.Types.LimiterHomotopy.NoHomotopy then
      limitedValue = smooth(0,if u > upperEffective then upperEffective else if u < lowerEffective then lowerEffective else u);
    else
      limitedValue = homotopy(actual = smooth(0,if u > upperEffective then upperEffective else if u < lowerEffective then lowerEffective else u),
                   simplified=simplifiedExpr);
    end if;
  end if;

  upperEffective=if faultMode==FaultMode.UpperLimitDrift then uMax+faultActivation*(upperFault-uMax) else uMax;
  lowerEffective=if faultMode==FaultMode.LowerLimitDrift then uMin+faultActivation*(lowerFault-uMin) else uMin;
  y=if faultMode==FaultMode.Stuck then limitedValue+faultActivation*(stuckValue-limitedValue) else limitedValue;
end FaultableLimiter;

model FaultableCCC "Linear current-controlled current source"
  import SI = Modelica.Units.SI;
  extends Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.TwoPort;
  parameter Real gain(start=1) "Current gain";

  type FaultMode = enumeration(Normal "正常", GainDrift "增益漂移", OutputLoss "输出损失", StuckGain "增益卡死");
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal "故障模式";
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1 "故障严重度";
  parameter SI.Time faultStartTime=1 "故障开始时刻";
  parameter SI.Time faultEndTime=3 "故障结束时刻";
  parameter SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05 "故障渐变时间";
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1) "含严重度的故障激活量";
  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  parameter Real gainFault=0.5*gain;
  Real gain_effective;

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  gain_effective = if faultMode == FaultMode.GainDrift or faultMode == FaultMode.StuckGain then gain + faultActivation*(gainFault - gain)
    elseif faultMode == FaultMode.OutputLoss then gain*(1 - faultActivation) else gain;
  i2 = i1*gain_effective;
  v1 = 0;
end FaultableCCC;

  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1) "含严重度的故障激活量";
  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  parameter SI.Resistance transResistanceFault=0.5*transResistance;
  SI.Resistance transResistance_effective;

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  transResistance_effective = if faultMode == FaultMode.TransresistanceDrift or faultMode == FaultMode.StuckGain then transResistance + faultActivation*(transResistanceFault - transResistance)
    elseif faultMode == FaultMode.OutputLoss then transResistance*(1 - faultActivation) else transResistance;
  v2 = i1*transResistance_effective;
  v1 = 0;
end FaultableCCV;

within MSLFaults.Electrical.Analog.Basic;
model FaultableCapacitor
  "Fault-enhanced MSL 4.0.0 capacitor with ESR and leakage branches"
  import SI = Modelica.Units.SI;
  extends Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.OnePort(v(start=0));
  parameter SI.Capacitance C(start=1) "Capacitance";

  type FaultMode = enumeration(
    Normal "Nominal MSL behavior",
    CapacitanceDrift "Progressive bidirectional capacitance drift",
    CapacitanceLoss "Abrupt or ramped capacitance loss",
    LeakageIncrease "Parallel leakage conductance increase",
    ESRIncrease "Series equivalent resistance increase",
    OpenCircuit "Finite series-resistance open circuit",
    ShortCircuit "Finite parallel-conductance short circuit");
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal;
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1;
  parameter SI.Time faultStartTime=1;
  parameter SI.Time faultEndTime=3;
  parameter SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05;
  parameter SI.Time driftTime(min=Modelica.Constants.small)=1
    "Time from drift onset to its calibrated target";
  parameter SI.Capacitance C_drift=1.2*C "Capacitance at completed drift";
  parameter SI.Capacitance C_loss=0.5*C "Capacitance after capacity loss";
  parameter SI.Conductance G_leakFault=1e-3 "Leakage target conductance";
  parameter SI.Conductance G_short=1e6 "Finite short-circuit conductance";
  parameter SI.Resistance R_seriesNominal=1e-9
    "Lower bound for the full-fault series resistance target";
  parameter SI.Resistance R_ESR=1 "Target series ESR";
  parameter SI.Resistance R_open=1e10 "Finite open-circuit series resistance";

  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real driftActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real driftProgress(min=0,max=1);
  SI.Capacitance C_effective "Fault-adjusted capacitance";
  SI.Conductance G_parallel "Always-present parallel leakage/short branch";
  SI.Resistance R_series "Always-present series ESR/open branch";
  SI.Voltage v_cap(start=0) "Voltage across capacitance and leakage branch";


public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";
  Modelica.Units.SI.ElectricCharge q "Stored charge";
  Modelica.Units.SI.Current i_leak;
  Modelica.Units.SI.Energy storedEnergy;
  Modelica.Units.SI.Power lossPower,parameterPower;
protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
initial equation
  assert(C>0 and C_loss>0 and C_drift>0 and driftTime>0,"Capacitances and drift time must be positive.");
  assert(G_leakFault>=0 and G_short>0 and R_seriesNominal>=0 and R_ESR>=0 and R_open>0,"Invalid capacitor loss targets.");
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  driftProgress=min(1,max(0,faultGate.elapsedActiveTime/driftTime));
  driftActivation=effectLevel*driftProgress;

  C_effective = if faultMode == FaultMode.CapacitanceDrift then
      C + driftActivation*(C_drift-C)
    elseif faultMode == FaultMode.CapacitanceLoss then
      C + faultActivation*(C_loss-C) else C;
  G_parallel = if faultMode == FaultMode.LeakageIncrease then
      faultActivation*G_leakFault
    elseif faultMode == FaultMode.ShortCircuit then
      faultActivation*G_short else 0;
  R_series = if faultMode == FaultMode.ESRIncrease then
      faultActivation*max(R_seriesNominal,R_ESR)
    elseif faultMode == FaultMode.OpenCircuit then
      faultActivation*max(R_seriesNominal,R_open) else 0;

  v = v_cap + R_series*i;
  q = C_effective*v_cap;
  i_leak=G_parallel*v_cap;
  der(q)=i-i_leak;


  storedEnergy=q*q/(2*C_effective);
  lossPower=R_series*i*i+G_parallel*v_cap*v_cap;
  parameterPower=der(storedEnergy)-v*i+lossPower;
end FaultableCapacitor;

within MSLFaults.Electrical.Analog.Basic;
model FaultableConductor "Ideal linear electrical conductor"
  import SI = Modelica.Units.SI;
  parameter SI.Conductance G(start=1)
    "Conductance at temperature T_ref";
  parameter SI.Temperature T_ref=300.15 "Reference temperature";
  parameter SI.LinearTemperatureCoefficient alpha=0
    "Temperature coefficient of conductance (G_actual = G_ref/(1 + alpha*(T_heatPort - T_ref))";
  extends Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.OnePort;
  extends Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.ConditionalHeatPort(T=T_ref);
  SI.Conductance G_actual
    "Actual conductance = G_ref/(1 + alpha*(T_heatPort - T_ref))";

  type FaultMode = enumeration(Normal "正常", ConductanceDrift "电导漂移", ConductanceStep "电导阶跃", OpenCircuit "低电导开路", ShortCircuit "高电导短路", TemperatureCoefficientDrift "温度系数漂移");
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal "故障模式";
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1 "故障严重度";
  parameter SI.Time faultStartTime=1 "故障开始时刻";
  parameter SI.Time faultEndTime=3 "故障结束时刻";
  parameter SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05 "故障渐变时间";
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1) "含严重度的故障激活量";
  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  parameter SI.Conductance G_fault=2*G "电导漂移目标值";
  parameter SI.Conductance G_open=1e-10 "开路有限小电导";
  parameter SI.Conductance G_short=1e6 "短路有限大电导";
  parameter SI.LinearTemperatureCoefficient alpha_fault=2*alpha "故障温度系数";
  SI.Conductance G_effective "故障后的参考电导";
  SI.LinearTemperatureCoefficient alpha_effective "故障后的温度系数";

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
initial equation
  assert(G_open>0 and G_short>0 and (1+alpha*(T_heatPort-T_ref))>0,"Finite electrical targets must be positive.");
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  G_effective = if faultMode == FaultMode.ConductanceDrift or faultMode == FaultMode.ConductanceStep then G + faultActivation*(G_fault - G)
    elseif faultMode == FaultMode.OpenCircuit then G + faultActivation*(G_open - G)
    elseif faultMode == FaultMode.ShortCircuit then G + faultActivation*(G_short - G) else G;
  alpha_effective = if faultMode == FaultMode.TemperatureCoefficientDrift then alpha + faultActivation*(alpha_fault - alpha) else alpha;
  assert((1 + alpha_effective*(T_heatPort - T_ref)) >= Modelica.Constants.eps,
    "Temperature outside scope of model!");
  G_actual=G_effective/(1+alpha_effective*(T_heatPort-T_ref));
  i = G_actual*v;
  LossPower = v*i;

  assert(1+alpha_effective*(T_heatPort-T_ref)>0,"Electrical temperature correction must stay positive.");
  assert(G_actual>=0,"The passive electrical parameter must be nonnegative.");
end FaultableConductor;

within MSLFaults.Electrical.Analog.Basic;
model FaultableGyrator "Gyrator"
  import SI = Modelica.Units.SI;
  extends Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.TwoPort;
  parameter SI.Conductance G1(start=1) "Primary gyration conductance";
  parameter SI.Conductance G2(start=1) "Secondary gyration conductance";
  type FaultMode = enumeration(Normal "正常", PrimaryGainDrift "原边回转电导漂移", SecondaryGainDrift "副边回转电导漂移", CouplingLoss "耦合损失");
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal "故障模式";
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1 "故障严重度";
  parameter SI.Time faultStartTime=1 "故障开始时刻";
  parameter SI.Time faultEndTime=3 "故障结束时刻";
  parameter SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05 "故障渐变时间";
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1) "含严重度的故障激活量";
  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  parameter SI.Conductance G1_fault=0.5*G1;
  parameter SI.Conductance G2_fault=0.5*G2;
  SI.Conductance G1_effective;
  SI.Conductance G2_effective;

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  G1_effective = if faultMode == FaultMode.PrimaryGainDrift or faultMode == FaultMode.CouplingLoss then G1 + faultActivation*(G1_fault - G1) else G1;
  G2_effective = if faultMode == FaultMode.SecondaryGainDrift or faultMode == FaultMode.CouplingLoss then G2 + faultActivation*(G2_fault - G2) else G2;
  i1 = G2_effective*v2;
  i2 = -G1_effective*v1;
end FaultableGyrator;

实现与使用契约：阅读本元件源码Implementation and usage contract: inspect the source
within MSLFaults.Electrical.Analog.Basic;
model FaultableInductor
  "Fault-enhanced MSL 4.0.0 inductor with winding and turn-short effects"
  import SI = Modelica.Units.SI;
  extends Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.OnePort(i(start=0));
  parameter SI.Inductance L(start=1) "Inductance";

  type FaultMode = enumeration(
    Normal "Nominal MSL behavior",
    InductanceDrift "Progressive inductance drift",
    InductanceLoss "Abrupt or ramped inductance loss",
    WindingResistanceIncrease "Series winding resistance increase",
    TurnShort "Reduced effective turns plus additional winding loss",
    OpenCircuit "Finite high-resistance winding open circuit");
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal;
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1;
  parameter SI.Time faultStartTime=1;
  parameter SI.Time faultEndTime=3;
  parameter SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05;
  parameter SI.Time driftTime(min=Modelica.Constants.small)=1;
  parameter SI.Inductance L_drift=1.2*L "Inductance at completed drift";
  parameter SI.Inductance L_loss=0.5*L "Inductance after discrete loss";
  parameter SI.Resistance R_windingFault=10 "Added winding resistance target";
  parameter Real maxTurnShortRatio(min=0,max=0.95)=0.3
    "Shorted-turn fraction at severity one";
  parameter SI.Resistance R_turnShortLoss=1
    "Series-equivalent loss at maximum shorted-turn fraction";
  parameter SI.Resistance R_open=1e10 "Finite open-circuit resistance";

  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real driftActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real driftProgress(min=0,max=1);
  Real turnShortRatio(min=0,max=0.95);
  SI.Inductance L_effective "Fault-adjusted inductance";
  SI.Resistance R_series "Fault-adjusted winding loss/open resistance";


public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";
  Modelica.Units.SI.MagneticFlux psi "Flux linkage";
  Modelica.Units.SI.Energy storedEnergy;
  Modelica.Units.SI.Power lossPower,parameterPower;
protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
initial equation
  assert(L>0 and L_loss>0 and L_drift>0 and driftTime>0,"Inductances and drift time must be positive.");
  assert(R_windingFault>=0 and R_turnShortLoss>=0 and R_open>0 and maxTurnShortRatio>=0 and maxTurnShortRatio<1,"Invalid winding-loss targets.");
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  driftProgress=min(1,max(0,faultGate.elapsedActiveTime/driftTime));
  driftActivation=effectLevel*driftProgress;
  turnShortRatio = if faultMode == FaultMode.TurnShort then
      faultActivation*maxTurnShortRatio else 0;

  L_effective = if faultMode == FaultMode.InductanceDrift then
      L + driftActivation*(L_drift-L)
    elseif faultMode == FaultMode.InductanceLoss then
      L + faultActivation*(L_loss-L)
    elseif faultMode == FaultMode.TurnShort then
      L*(1-turnShortRatio)^2 else L;
  R_series = if faultMode == FaultMode.WindingResistanceIncrease then
      faultActivation*R_windingFault
    elseif faultMode == FaultMode.TurnShort then
      faultActivation*R_turnShortLoss
    elseif faultMode == FaultMode.OpenCircuit then
      faultActivation*R_open else 0;

  v=der(psi)+R_series*i;


  psi=L_effective*i;
  storedEnergy=psi*psi/(2*L_effective);
  lossPower=R_series*i*i;
  parameterPower=der(storedEnergy)-v*i+lossPower;
end FaultableInductor;

within MSLFaults.Electrical.Analog.Basic;
model FaultablePotentiometer "Adjustable resistor"
  import SI = Modelica.Units.SI;
  parameter SI.Resistance R(start=1)
    "Resistance at temperature T_ref";
  parameter SI.Temperature T_ref=293.15 "Reference temperature";
  parameter SI.LinearTemperatureCoefficient alpha=0
    "Temperature coefficient of resistance (R_actual = R*(1 + alpha*(T_heatPort - T_ref))";
  extends Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.ConditionalHeatPort(T=T_ref);
  parameter Boolean useRinput=false "Use input for 0<r<1 (else constant)"
  parameter Real rConstant(
    final min=0,
    final max=1) = 0.5 "Contact between n (r=0) and p (r=1)"
  SI.Resistance Rp
    "Actual resistance between pin_p and contact";
  SI.Resistance Rn
    "Actual resistance between contact and pin_n";
  Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.PositivePin pin_p
  Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.PositivePin contact ;
  Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.NegativePin pin_n
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.RealInput r if useRinput ;
  type FaultMode = enumeration(Normal "正常", TotalResistanceDrift "总阻值漂移", WiperBias "滑片偏置", WiperStuck "滑片卡死", ContactOpen "滑片接触开路");
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal "故障模式";
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1 "故障严重度";
  parameter SI.Time faultStartTime=1 "故障开始时刻";
  parameter SI.Time faultEndTime=3 "故障结束时刻";
  parameter SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05 "故障渐变时间";
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1) "含严重度的故障激活量";
  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  parameter SI.Resistance R_fault=2*R "总阻值故障目标";
  parameter Real wiperBias=0.1 "滑片偏置";
  parameter Real wiperStuckValue(min=0,max=1)=0.5 "滑片卡死位置";
  parameter SI.Resistance R_contactOpen=1e10 "接触开路有限大电阻";
  SI.Resistance R_effective "故障后的总电阻";
  Real r_effective "故障后的滑片位置";
  SI.Resistance R_contact "故障后的滑片接触电阻";
protected
  Modelica.Blocks.Sources.Constant rConst(final k=rConstant) if not useRinput
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.RealInput rInt
public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  pin_p.i + pin_n.i + contact.i = 0;
  R_effective = if faultMode == FaultMode.TotalResistanceDrift then R + faultActivation*(R_fault - R) else R;
  r_effective = if faultMode == FaultMode.WiperBias then min(1, max(0, rInt + faultActivation*wiperBias))
    elseif faultMode == FaultMode.WiperStuck then rInt + faultActivation*(wiperStuckValue - rInt) else min(1, max(0, rInt));
  R_contact = if faultMode == FaultMode.ContactOpen then faultActivation*R_contactOpen else 0;
  Rp = R_effective*(1 + alpha*(T_heatPort - T_ref))*(1 - r_effective);
  Rn = R_effective*(1 + alpha*(T_heatPort - T_ref))*r_effective;
  pin_p.v - contact.v = (Rp + R_contact)*pin_p.i;
  pin_n.v - contact.v = (Rn + R_contact)*pin_n.i;
  LossPower = (pin_p.v - contact.v)*pin_p.i + (pin_n.v - contact.v)*pin_n.i;
  connect(rInt, r) ;
  connect(rInt, rConst.y) ;
end FaultablePotentiometer;

model FaultableResistor
  "Fault-enhanced MSL 4.0.0 resistor with distinct drift and step laws"
  import SI = Modelica.Units.SI;

  parameter SI.Resistance R(start=1) "Resistance at reference temperature";
  parameter SI.Temperature T_ref=300.15 "Reference temperature";
  parameter SI.LinearTemperatureCoefficient alpha=0
    "Temperature coefficient of resistance";

  extends Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.OnePort;
  extends Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.ConditionalHeatPort(T=T_ref);

  type FaultMode = enumeration(
      Normal "Nominal MSL behavior",
      ResistanceDrift "Progressive resistance drift",
      ResistanceStep "Abrupt resistance change",
      OpenCircuit "Finite high-resistance open circuit",
      ShortCircuit "Finite low-resistance short circuit",
      TemperatureCoefficientDrift "Progressive temperature-coefficient drift");

  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal "Selected fault mode";
  parameter Real severity(min=0, max=1)=1 "Fault severity";
  parameter SI.Time faultStartTime=1 "Fault start time";
  parameter SI.Time faultEndTime=3 "Fault end time";
  parameter SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05 "Activation/deactivation ramp time";
  parameter SI.Time driftTime(min=Modelica.Constants.small)=1
    "Time from drift onset to its calibrated target";
  parameter SI.Resistance R_drift=2*R "Resistance at completed drift";
  parameter SI.Resistance R_step=2*R "Resistance after an abrupt step";
  parameter SI.Resistance R_open(min=Modelica.Constants.small)=1e10
    "Finite resistance representing an open circuit";
  parameter SI.Resistance R_short(min=Modelica.Constants.small)=1e-6
    "Finite resistance representing a short circuit";
  parameter SI.LinearTemperatureCoefficient alpha_fault=2*alpha
    "Temperature coefficient at completed drift";

  SI.Resistance R_actual
    "Temperature-adjusted resistance used by the constitutive equation";
  SI.Resistance R_effective "Fault-adjusted reference resistance";
  SI.LinearTemperatureCoefficient alpha_effective
    "Fault-adjusted temperature coefficient";
  Real faultActivation(min=0, max=1) "Severity-scaled activation envelope";
  Real driftActivation(min=0, max=1) "Severity-scaled progressive drift";
  Real startActivation(min=0, max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0, max=1);
  Real driftProgress(min=0, max=1);


public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
initial equation
  assert(R_open>0 and R_short>0 and (1+alpha*(T_heatPort-T_ref))>0,"Finite electrical targets must be positive.");
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  driftProgress=min(1,max(0,faultGate.elapsedActiveTime/driftTime));
  driftActivation=effectLevel*driftProgress;

  R_effective = if faultMode == FaultMode.ResistanceDrift then
      R + driftActivation*(R_drift - R)
    elseif faultMode == FaultMode.ResistanceStep then
      R + faultActivation*(R_step - R)
    elseif faultMode == FaultMode.OpenCircuit then
      R + faultActivation*(R_open - R)
    elseif faultMode == FaultMode.ShortCircuit then
      R + faultActivation*(R_short - R)
    else R;
  alpha_effective = if faultMode == FaultMode.TemperatureCoefficientDrift then
      alpha + driftActivation*(alpha_fault - alpha) else alpha;

  assert((1 + alpha_effective*(T_heatPort - T_ref)) >= Modelica.Constants.eps,
    "Temperature outside the valid linear resistance model range");
  R_actual=R_effective*(1+alpha_effective*(T_heatPort-T_ref));
  v = R_actual*i;
  LossPower = v*i;


  assert(1+alpha_effective*(T_heatPort-T_ref)>0,"Electrical temperature correction must stay positive.");
  assert(R_actual>=0,"The passive electrical parameter must be nonnegative.");
end FaultableResistor;

within MSLFaults.Electrical.Analog.Basic;
model FaultableTransformer "Transformer with two ports"
  import SI = Modelica.Units.SI;
  extends Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.TwoPort(i1(start=0),i2(start=0));
  parameter SI.Inductance L1(start=1) "Primary inductance";
  parameter SI.Inductance L2(start=1) "Secondary inductance";
  parameter SI.Inductance M(start=1) "Coupling inductance";
  Real dv "Difference between voltage drop over primary inductor and voltage drop over secondary inductor";
  type FaultMode = enumeration(Normal "正常", PrimaryInductanceDrift "原边电感漂移", SecondaryInductanceDrift "副边电感漂移", CouplingLoss "耦合损失", PrimaryOpen "原边开路", SecondaryOpen "副边开路");
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal "故障模式";
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1 "故障严重度";
  parameter SI.Time faultStartTime=1 "故障开始时刻";
  parameter SI.Time faultEndTime=3 "故障结束时刻";
  parameter SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05 "故障渐变时间";
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1) "含严重度的故障激活量";
  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  parameter SI.Inductance L1_fault=0.5*L1 "原边电感故障目标";
  parameter SI.Inductance L2_fault=0.5*L2 "副边电感故障目标";
  parameter SI.Inductance M_fault=0.1*M "耦合电感故障目标";
  parameter SI.Resistance R_open=1e10 "绕组开路有限大电阻";
  SI.Inductance L1_effective;
  SI.Inductance L2_effective;
  SI.Inductance M_effective;
  SI.Resistance R1_series;
  SI.Resistance R2_series;

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  L1_effective = if faultMode == FaultMode.PrimaryInductanceDrift then L1 + faultActivation*(L1_fault - L1) else L1;
  L2_effective = if faultMode == FaultMode.SecondaryInductanceDrift then L2 + faultActivation*(L2_fault - L2) else L2;
  M_effective = if faultMode == FaultMode.CouplingLoss then M + faultActivation*(M_fault - M) else M;
  R1_series = if faultMode == FaultMode.PrimaryOpen then faultActivation*R_open else 0;
  R2_series = if faultMode == FaultMode.SecondaryOpen then faultActivation*R_open else 0;
  v1 = L1_effective*der(i1) + M_effective*der(i2) + R1_series*i1;
  v2 = M_effective*der(i1) + L2_effective*der(i2) + R2_series*i2;
  dv = v1 - v2;
end FaultableTransformer;

within MSLFaults.Electrical.Analog.Basic;
model FaultableVariableCapacitor
  "Ideal linear electrical capacitor with variable capacitance"
  import SI = Modelica.Units.SI;
  extends Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.OnePort;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.RealInput C(unit="F") ;
  parameter SI.Capacitance Cmin=Modelica.Constants.eps
    "Lower bound for variable capacitance";
  SI.ElectricCharge Q;
  parameter SI.Voltage IC=0 "Initial Value";
  parameter Boolean UIC=false "Decision if initial value IC shall be used";
  type FaultMode = enumeration(Normal "正常", CapacitanceScaleError "输入容量比例误差", CapacitanceBias "输入容量偏置", StuckInput "容量输入卡死", CapacitanceLoss "容量损失");
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal "故障模式";
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1 "故障严重度";
  parameter SI.Time faultStartTime=1 "故障开始时刻";
  parameter SI.Time faultEndTime=3 "故障结束时刻";
  parameter SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05 "故障渐变时间";
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1) "含严重度的故障激活量";
  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  parameter Real scaleFault=0.5 "比例故障目标";
  parameter SI.Capacitance biasFault=1e-6 "偏置故障目标";
  parameter SI.Capacitance stuckValue=1e-6 "卡死容量";
  parameter SI.Capacitance lossValue=Cmin "容量损失目标";
  SI.Capacitance C_effective "故障后的命令容量";

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
initial equation
  if UIC then
    v = IC;
  end if;
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  assert(C >= 0, "Capacitance C (= " + String(C) + ") has to be >= 0!");
  // protect solver from index change
  C_effective = if faultMode == FaultMode.CapacitanceScaleError then C*(1 + faultActivation*(scaleFault - 1))
    elseif faultMode == FaultMode.CapacitanceBias then C + faultActivation*biasFault
    elseif faultMode == FaultMode.StuckInput then C + faultActivation*(stuckValue - C)
    elseif faultMode == FaultMode.CapacitanceLoss then C + faultActivation*(lossValue - C) else C;
  Q = noEvent(max(C_effective, Cmin))*v;
  i = der(Q);
end FaultableVariableCapacitor;

within MSLFaults.Electrical.Analog.Basic;
model FaultableVariableConductor
  "Ideal linear electrical conductor with variable conductance"
  import SI = Modelica.Units.SI;
  parameter SI.Temperature T_ref=300.15 "Reference temperature";
  parameter SI.LinearTemperatureCoefficient alpha=0
    "Temperature coefficient of conductance (G_actual = G/(1 + alpha*(T_heatPort - T_ref))";
  extends Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.OnePort;
  extends Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.ConditionalHeatPort(T=T_ref);
  SI.Conductance G_actual
    "Actual conductance = G/(1 + alpha*(T_heatPort - T_ref))";
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.RealInput G(unit="S") ;
  type FaultMode = enumeration(Normal "正常", ConductanceScaleError "输入电导比例误差", ConductanceBias "输入电导偏置", OpenCircuit "低电导开路", ShortCircuit "高电导短路");
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal "故障模式";
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1 "故障严重度";
  parameter SI.Time faultStartTime=1 "故障开始时刻";
  parameter SI.Time faultEndTime=3 "故障结束时刻";
  parameter SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05 "故障渐变时间";
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1) "含严重度的故障激活量";
  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  parameter Real scaleFault=0.5 "比例故障目标";
  parameter SI.Conductance biasFault=1 "偏置故障目标";
  parameter SI.Conductance G_open=1e-10 "开路有限小电导";
  parameter SI.Conductance G_short=1e6 "短路有限大电导";
  SI.Conductance G_effective "故障后的命令电导";

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  assert((1 + alpha*(T_heatPort - T_ref)) >= Modelica.Constants.eps,
    "Temperature outside scope of model!");
  G_effective = if faultMode == FaultMode.ConductanceScaleError then G*(1 + faultActivation*(scaleFault - 1))
    elseif faultMode == FaultMode.ConductanceBias then G + faultActivation*biasFault
    elseif faultMode == FaultMode.OpenCircuit then G + faultActivation*(G_open - G)
    elseif faultMode == FaultMode.ShortCircuit then G + faultActivation*(G_short - G) else G;
  G_actual = G_effective/(1 + alpha*(T_heatPort - T_ref));
  i = G_actual*v;
  LossPower = v*i;
end FaultableVariableConductor;

  "Ideal linear electrical resistor with variable resistance"
  import SI = Modelica.Units.SI;

  parameter SI.LinearTemperatureCoefficient alpha=0
    "Temperature coefficient of resistance (R_actual = R*(1 + alpha*(T_heatPort - T_ref))";

    "Actual resistance = R*(1 + alpha*(T_heatPort - T_ref))";
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.RealInput R(unit="Ohm") ;
  type FaultMode = enumeration(Normal "正常", ResistanceScaleError "输入电阻比例误差", ResistanceBias "输入电阻偏置", OpenCircuit "有限大阻值开路", ShortCircuit "有限小阻值短路");
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal "故障模式";
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1 "故障严重度";
  parameter SI.Time faultStartTime=1 "故障开始时刻";
  parameter SI.Time faultEndTime=3 "故障结束时刻";
  parameter SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05 "故障渐变时间";
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1) "含严重度的故障激活量";
  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  parameter Real scaleFault=0.5 "比例故障目标";
  parameter SI.Resistance biasFault=1 "偏置故障目标";
  parameter SI.Resistance R_open=1e10 "开路有限大电阻";
  parameter SI.Resistance R_short=1e-6 "短路有限小电阻";
  SI.Resistance R_effective "故障后的命令电阻";

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  assert((1 + alpha*(T_heatPort - T_ref)) >= Modelica.Constants.eps,
    "Temperature outside scope of model!");
  R_effective = if faultMode == FaultMode.ResistanceScaleError then R*(1 + faultActivation*(scaleFault - 1))
    elseif faultMode == FaultMode.ResistanceBias then R + faultActivation*biasFault
    elseif faultMode == FaultMode.OpenCircuit then R + faultActivation*(R_open - R)
    elseif faultMode == FaultMode.ShortCircuit then R + faultActivation*(R_short - R) else R;
  R_actual = R_effective*(1 + alpha*(T_heatPort - T_ref));
  v = R_actual*i;
  LossPower = v*i;
end FaultableVariableResistor;

within MSLFaults.Electrical.Analog.Ideal;
model FaultableControlledIdealClosingSwitch "ControlledIdealClosingSwitch independent fault model"
  extends Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.OnePort;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Resistance Ron(final min=0)=1e-5;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Conductance Goff(final min=0)=1e-5;
  extends Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.ConditionalHeatPort(final T=293.15);
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Voltage level=0.5 "Switch level";
  Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.Pin control "Control pin" ;
  type FaultMode=enumeration(Normal "正常", StuckOpen "卡在开路", StuckClosed "卡在闭合", ContactResistanceIncrease "接触电阻增加", LeakageIncrease "关断泄漏增加");
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal;
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultStartTime=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultEndTime=3;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05;
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Resistance RonFault=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Conductance GoffFault=1e-2;
  Boolean off;
  Boolean naturalOff;
  Real s(final unit="1");
  constant Modelica.Units.SI.Voltage unitVoltage=1;
  constant Modelica.Units.SI.Current unitCurrent=1;
  Modelica.Units.SI.Resistance Ron_effective;
  Modelica.Units.SI.Conductance Goff_effective;

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  control.i=0;
  naturalOff=control.v < level;
  off=if faultMode==FaultMode.StuckOpen and faultActivation>0.5 then true elseif faultMode==FaultMode.StuckClosed and faultActivation>0.5 then false else naturalOff;
  Ron_effective=if faultMode==FaultMode.ContactResistanceIncrease then Ron+faultActivation*(RonFault-Ron) else Ron;
  Goff_effective=if faultMode==FaultMode.LeakageIncrease then Goff+faultActivation*(GoffFault-Goff) else Goff;
  v=(s*unitCurrent)*(if off then 1 else Ron_effective);
  i=(s*unitVoltage)*(if off then Goff_effective else 1);
  LossPower=v*i;
end FaultableControlledIdealClosingSwitch;

within MSLFaults.Electrical.Analog.Ideal;
model FaultableControlledIdealIntermediateSwitch
  "Controlled ideal intermediate switch"
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Voltage level=0.5 "Switch level";
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Resistance Ron(final min=0) = 1e-5 "Closed switch resistance";
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Conductance Goff(final min=0) = 1e-5
    "Opened switch conductance";
  extends Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.ConditionalHeatPort(final T=
        293.15);
  Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.PositivePin p1 ;
  Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.PositivePin p2 ;
  Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.NegativePin n1 ;
  Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.NegativePin n2 ;
  Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.Pin control "Control pin: if control.v > level p1--n2, p2--n1 connected,
         otherwise p1--n1, p2--n2  connected"
  type FaultMode=enumeration(Normal "正常", StuckPosition1 "卡在位置一", StuckPosition2 "卡在位置二", ContactResistanceIncrease "接触电阻增加", LeakageIncrease "关断泄漏增加");
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal;
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultStartTime=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultEndTime=3;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05;
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Resistance RonFault=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Conductance GoffFault=1e-2;
  Boolean control_effective;
  Boolean control_command;
  Modelica.Units.SI.Resistance Ron_effective;
  Modelica.Units.SI.Conductance Goff_effective;
protected
  Real s1(final unit="1");
  Real s2(final unit="1");
  Real s3(final unit="1");
  Real s4(final unit="1") "Auxiliary variables";
  constant Modelica.Units.SI.Voltage unitVoltage=1 ;
  constant Modelica.Units.SI.Current unitCurrent=1 ;

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  control_command=control.v > level;
  control.i=0;
  control_effective=if faultMode==FaultMode.StuckPosition1 and faultActivation>0.5 then false elseif faultMode==FaultMode.StuckPosition2 and faultActivation>0.5 then true else control_command;
  Ron_effective=if faultMode==FaultMode.ContactResistanceIncrease then Ron+faultActivation*(RonFault-Ron) else Ron;
  Goff_effective=if faultMode==FaultMode.LeakageIncrease then Goff+faultActivation*(GoffFault-Goff) else Goff;


  p1.v - n1.v = (s1*unitCurrent)*(if (control_effective) then 1 else Ron_effective);
  p2.v - n2.v = (s2*unitCurrent)*(if (control_effective) then 1 else Ron_effective);
  p1.v - n2.v = (s3*unitCurrent)*(if (control_effective) then Ron_effective else 1);
  p2.v - n1.v = (s4*unitCurrent)*(if (control_effective) then Ron_effective else 1);

  p1.i = if control_effective then s1*unitVoltage*Goff_effective + s3*unitCurrent else
    s1*unitCurrent + s3*unitVoltage*Goff_effective;
  p2.i = if control_effective then s2*unitVoltage*Goff_effective + s4*unitCurrent else
    s2*unitCurrent + s4*unitVoltage*Goff_effective;
  n1.i = if control_effective then -s1*unitVoltage*Goff_effective - s4*unitCurrent
     else -s1*unitCurrent - s4*unitVoltage*Goff_effective;
  n2.i = if control_effective then -s2*unitVoltage*Goff_effective - s3*unitCurrent
     else -s2*unitCurrent - s3*unitVoltage*Goff_effective;

  LossPower = p1.i*p1.v + p2.i*p2.v + n1.i*n1.v + n2.i*n2.v;
end FaultableControlledIdealIntermediateSwitch;

  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Conductance GoffFault=1e-2;
  Boolean off;
  Boolean naturalOff;
  Real s(final unit="1");
  constant Modelica.Units.SI.Voltage unitVoltage=1;
  constant Modelica.Units.SI.Current unitCurrent=1;
  Modelica.Units.SI.Resistance Ron_effective;
  Modelica.Units.SI.Conductance Goff_effective;

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  control.i=0;
  naturalOff=control.v > level;
  off=if faultMode==FaultMode.StuckOpen and faultActivation>0.5 then true elseif faultMode==FaultMode.StuckClosed and faultActivation>0.5 then false else naturalOff;
  Ron_effective=if faultMode==FaultMode.ContactResistanceIncrease then Ron+faultActivation*(RonFault-Ron) else Ron;
  Goff_effective=if faultMode==FaultMode.LeakageIncrease then Goff+faultActivation*(GoffFault-Goff) else Goff;
  v=(s*unitCurrent)*(if off then 1 else Ron_effective);
  i=(s*unitVoltage)*(if off then Goff_effective else 1);
  LossPower=v*i;
end FaultableControlledIdealOpeningSwitch;

        293.15);

  Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.NegativePin n2 ;
  Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.NegativePin n1 ;
  Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.Pin control
    "Control pin: if control.v > level p--n2 connected, otherwise p--n1 connected"
  type FaultMode=enumeration(Normal "正常", StuckPosition1 "卡在位置一", StuckPosition2 "卡在位置二", ContactResistanceIncrease "接触电阻增加", LeakageIncrease "关断泄漏增加");
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal;
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultStartTime=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultEndTime=3;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05;
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Resistance RonFault=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Conductance GoffFault=1e-2;
  Boolean control_effective;
  Boolean control_command;
  Modelica.Units.SI.Resistance Ron_effective;
  Modelica.Units.SI.Conductance Goff_effective;
protected
  Real s1(final unit="1");
  Real s2(final unit="1") "Auxiliary variables";
  constant Modelica.Units.SI.Voltage unitVoltage=1 ;
  constant Modelica.Units.SI.Current unitCurrent=1 ;

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  control_command=control.v > level;
  control.i=0;
  control_effective=if faultMode==FaultMode.StuckPosition1 and faultActivation>0.5 then false elseif faultMode==FaultMode.StuckPosition2 and faultActivation>0.5 then true else control_command;
  Ron_effective=if faultMode==FaultMode.ContactResistanceIncrease then Ron+faultActivation*(RonFault-Ron) else Ron;
  Goff_effective=if faultMode==FaultMode.LeakageIncrease then Goff+faultActivation*(GoffFault-Goff) else Goff;

  0 = p.i + n2.i + n1.i;

  p.v - n1.v = (s1*unitCurrent)*(if (control_effective) then 1 else Ron_effective);
  n1.i = -(s1*unitVoltage)*(if (control_effective) then Goff_effective else 1);
  p.v - n2.v = (s2*unitCurrent)*(if (control_effective) then Ron_effective else 1);
  n2.i = -(s2*unitVoltage)*(if (control_effective) then 1 else Goff_effective);
  LossPower = p.i*p.v + n1.i*n1.v + n2.i*n2.v;
end FaultableControlledIdealTwoWaySwitch;

model FaultableIdealDiode "Ideal diode with independent fault physics"
  extends Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.OnePort;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Resistance Ron(final min=0)=1e-5 "Forward state-on differential resistance";
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Conductance Goff(final min=0)=1e-5 "Backward state-off conductance";
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Voltage Vknee(final min=0)=0 "Forward threshold voltage";
  extends Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Interfaces.ConditionalHeatPort;
  type FaultMode=enumeration(Normal "正常", OpenCircuit "强制开路", ShortCircuit "强制短路", ForwardVoltageDrift "正向压降漂移", LeakageIncrease "反向泄漏增加");
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal;
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultStartTime=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultEndTime=3;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05;
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Resistance R_short=1e-6;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Conductance G_open=1e-10;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Conductance G_leakFault=1e-2;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Voltage VkneeFault=1;
  Boolean off(start=true);
  Boolean naturalOff;
  Real s(start=0,final unit="1");
  constant Modelica.Units.SI.Voltage unitVoltage=1;
  constant Modelica.Units.SI.Current unitCurrent=1;
  Modelica.Units.SI.Resistance Ron_effective;
  Modelica.Units.SI.Conductance Goff_effective;
  Modelica.Units.SI.Voltage Vknee_effective;

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  naturalOff = s < 0;
  off = if faultMode==FaultMode.OpenCircuit and faultActivation>0.5 then true
    elseif faultMode==FaultMode.ShortCircuit and faultActivation>0.5 then false else naturalOff;
  Ron_effective = if faultMode==FaultMode.ShortCircuit then Ron+faultActivation*(R_short-Ron) else Ron;
  Goff_effective = if faultMode==FaultMode.OpenCircuit then Goff+faultActivation*(G_open-Goff)
    elseif faultMode==FaultMode.LeakageIncrease then Goff+faultActivation*(G_leakFault-Goff) else Goff;
  Vknee_effective = if faultMode==FaultMode.ForwardVoltageDrift then Vknee+faultActivation*(VkneeFault-Vknee) else Vknee;
  v=(s*unitCurrent)*(if off then 1 else Ron_effective)+Vknee_effective;
  i=(s*unitVoltage)*(if off then Goff_effective else 1)+Goff_effective*Vknee_effective;
  LossPower=v*i;
end FaultableIdealDiode;
