within MSLFaults.Mechanics.Translational.Sensors;
model FaultableAccSensor "Independent fault-enhanced MSL 4.0.0 Translational.AccSensor"
  extends Modelica.Mechanics.Translational.Interfaces.PartialAbsoluteSensor;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.RealOutput a(unit="m/s2") ;
  type FaultMode=enumeration(Normal, Bias, GainError, NoiseIncrease, Stuck, Dropout, Saturation);
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal;
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultStartTime=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultEndTime=3;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05;
  parameter Real biasFault=1;
  parameter Real gainFault=0.5;
  parameter Real stuckValue=0;
  parameter Real saturationLimit=1e9;
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1),startActivation(min=0,max=1),endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real a_raw,a_faulted;
  Modelica.Units.SI.Velocity v_internal;
  // Preserve the nominal sensor's differentiated intermediate state.

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  v_internal=der(flange.s);
  a_raw=der(v_internal);
  a_faulted=if faultMode==FaultMode.Bias then a_raw+faultActivation*biasFault elseif faultMode==FaultMode.GainError then a_raw*(1+faultActivation*(gainFault-1)) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.NoiseIncrease then a_raw+faultActivation*biasFault*sin(997*time) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Stuck then a_raw+faultActivation*(stuckValue-a_raw) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Dropout then (1-faultActivation)*a_raw elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Saturation then min(saturationLimit,max(-saturationLimit,a_raw)) else a_raw;
  a=a_faulted;
end FaultableAccSensor;

model FaultableForceSensor "Independent fault-enhanced MSL 4.0.0 Translational.ForceSensor"
  extends Modelica.Mechanics.Translational.Interfaces.PartialRelativeSensor;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.RealOutput f(unit="N") ;
  type FaultMode=enumeration(Normal, Bias, GainError, NoiseIncrease, Stuck, Dropout, Saturation);
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal;
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultStartTime=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultEndTime=3;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05;
  parameter Real biasFault=1;
  parameter Real gainFault=0.5;
  parameter Real stuckValue=0;
  parameter Real saturationLimit=1e9;
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1),startActivation(min=0,max=1),endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real f_raw,f_faulted;

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  flange_a.s=flange_b.s;
  f_raw=flange_a.f;
  f_faulted=if faultMode==FaultMode.Bias then f_raw+faultActivation*biasFault elseif faultMode==FaultMode.GainError then f_raw*(1+faultActivation*(gainFault-1)) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.NoiseIncrease then f_raw+faultActivation*biasFault*sin(997*time) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Stuck then f_raw+faultActivation*(stuckValue-f_raw) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Dropout then (1-faultActivation)*f_raw elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Saturation then min(saturationLimit,max(-saturationLimit,f_raw)) else f_raw;
  f=f_faulted;
end FaultableForceSensor;

  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultEndTime=3;

  parameter Real biasFault=1;
  parameter Real gainFault=0.5;
  parameter Real stuckValue=0;
  parameter Real saturationLimit=1e9;
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1),startActivation(min=0,max=1),endActivation(min=0,max=1),s_rel_raw;

public

protected

    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;

  s_rel_raw=flange_b.s-flange_a.s;
  0=flange_a.f;

model FaultableOneWayValve "Simple one-way valve"
  extends Modelica.Thermal.FluidHeatFlow.BaseClasses.TwoPort(m(start=0), final tapT=1);

  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.VolumeFlowRate V_flowNominal(start=1) "Nominal volume flow rate (forward)";
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Pressure dpForward(displayUnit="bar")=1e-6 "Pressure drop at nominal flow (forward)";
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Pressure dpNominal(displayUnit="bar", start=1e5) "Nominal pressure (backward)";
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.VolumeFlowRate V_flowBackward(start=1E-6) "Leakage volume flow rate (backward)";
  parameter Real frictionLoss(min=0, max=1, start=0)
    "Part of friction losses fed to medium";
  Boolean backward(start=true) "State forward=false / backward=true";
protected
  Real s(start=0, final unit="1")
    "Auxiliary variable for actual position on the valve characteristic";
  /* s < 0: backward, leakage flow
         s > 0: forward, small pressure drop */
  constant Modelica.Units.SI.VolumeFlowRate unitVolumeFlowRate = 1;
public
  constant Modelica.Units.SI.Pressure unitPressureDrop = 1;  type FaultMode=enumeration(Normal "正常", StuckClosed "单向阀卡闭", StuckOpen "单向阀卡开", ForwardResistanceIncrease "正向阻力增加", ReverseLeakageIncrease "反向泄漏增加");
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal;
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultStartTime=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultEndTime=3;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05;
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Pressure dpForwardFault=10*dpForward;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.VolumeFlowRate reverseLeakFault=100*V_flowBackward;
  Modelica.Units.SI.Pressure dpForward_effective;
  Modelica.Units.SI.VolumeFlowRate V_flowBackward_effective;
  Boolean backward_effective;

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  backward_effective=if faultMode==FaultMode.StuckClosed and faultActivation>0.5 then true elseif faultMode==FaultMode.StuckOpen and faultActivation>0.5 then false else s<0;
  backward=backward_effective;
  dpForward_effective=if faultMode==FaultMode.ForwardResistanceIncrease or faultMode==FaultMode.StuckClosed then dpForward+faultActivation*(dpForwardFault-dpForward) else dpForward;
  V_flowBackward_effective=if faultMode==FaultMode.ReverseLeakageIncrease or faultMode==FaultMode.StuckOpen then V_flowBackward+faultActivation*(reverseLeakFault-V_flowBackward) else V_flowBackward;
  dp=(s*unitVolumeFlowRate)*(if backward_effective then 1 else dpForward_effective/V_flowNominal);
  V_flow=(s*unitPressureDrop)*(if backward_effective then V_flowBackward_effective/dpNominal else 1);
  Q_flow = frictionLoss*V_flow*dp;
end FaultableOneWayValve;

  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Acceleration g(final min=0)=Modelica.Constants.g_n "Gravitation";
  Modelica.Thermal.HeatTransfer.Interfaces.HeatPort_a heatPort(T=T_q, Q_flow=Q_flowHeatPort) if useHeatPort
  type FaultMode=enumeration(Normal "正常", PressureLossIncrease "压降增加", Blockage "堵塞", Leakage "泄漏", HeatTransferLoss "换热损失");
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal;
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultStartTime=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultEndTime=3;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05;
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Pressure pressureDropFault=1e5;
  parameter Real heatTransferScaleFault(min=0)=0.5;
  Modelica.Units.SI.Pressure addedPressureDrop;
  Real heatTransferScale;
protected
  Modelica.Units.SI.HeatFlowRate Q_flowHeatPort "Heat flow at conditional heatPort";

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  if not useHeatPort then
    Q_flowHeatPort=0;
  end if;
  // coupling with FrictionModel
  volumeFlow = V_flow;
  addedPressureDrop=if faultMode==FaultMode.PressureLossIncrease then faultActivation*pressureDropFault*sign(V_flow) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Blockage then faultActivation*1e9*V_flow elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Leakage then -faultActivation*0.5*pressureDrop else 0;
  dp=pressureDrop+medium.rho*g*h_g+addedPressureDrop;
  // energy exchange with medium
  heatTransferScale=if faultMode==FaultMode.HeatTransferLoss then 1+faultActivation*(heatTransferScaleFault-1) else 1;
  Q_flow=heatTransferScale*Q_flowHeatPort+Q_friction;
end FaultablePipe;

within MSLFaults.Thermal.FluidHeatFlow.Components;
model FaultableValve "Simple valve"
  extends Modelica.Thermal.FluidHeatFlow.BaseClasses.TwoPort(m(start=0), final tapT=1);

  parameter Boolean LinearCharacteristic(start=true)
    "Type of characteristic"
  parameter Real y1(min=small, start=1) "Max. valve opening"
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.VolumeFlowRate Kv1(min=small, start=1)
    "Max. flow @ y = y1"
  parameter Real kv0(min=small,max=1-small, start=0.01)
    "Leakage flow / max.flow @ y = 0"
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Pressure dp0(start=1) "Standard pressure drop"
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Density rho0(start=10)
    "Standard medium's density"
  parameter Real frictionLoss(min=0, max=1, start=0)
    "Part of friction losses fed to medium";
  type FaultMode=enumeration(Normal "正常", StuckClosed "阀门卡闭", StuckOpen "阀门卡开", OpeningBias "开度偏置", LeakageIncrease "泄漏增加", Blockage "堵塞");
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal;
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultStartTime=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultEndTime=3;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05;
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  parameter Real stuckOpening(min=0)=0;
  parameter Real openingBias=0.1;
  parameter Real leakageFault(min=Modelica.Constants.small,max=1)=0.1;
  Real y_effective;
  Real kv0_effective;
protected
  constant Modelica.Units.SI.VolumeFlowRate unitVolumeFlowRate = 1;
  constant Real small = Modelica.Constants.small;
  constant Modelica.Units.SI.VolumeFlowRate smallVolumeFlowRate = eps*unitVolumeFlowRate;
  constant Real eps = Modelica.Constants.eps;
  Real yLim "Limited fault-affected valve opening";
  Modelica.Units.SI.VolumeFlowRate Kv "Standard flow rate";
public
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.RealInput y ;

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
initial algorithm
  assert(y1>small, "Valve characteristic: y1 has to be > 0 !");
  assert(Kv1>smallVolumeFlowRate, "Valve characteristic: Kv1 has to be > 0 !");
  assert(kv0>small, "Valve characteristic: kv0 has to be > 0 !");
  assert(kv0<1-eps, "Valve characteristic: kv0 has to be < 1 !");
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  y_effective=if faultMode==FaultMode.StuckClosed then y+faultActivation*(stuckOpening-y) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.StuckOpen then y+faultActivation*(y1-y) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.OpeningBias then y+faultActivation*openingBias elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Blockage then y*(1-faultActivation) else y;
  kv0_effective=if faultMode==FaultMode.LeakageIncrease then kv0+faultActivation*(leakageFault-kv0) else kv0;
  yLim=max(min(y_effective,y1),0);
  // evaluate standard characteristic
  Kv/Kv1=if LinearCharacteristic then (kv0_effective+(1-kv0_effective)*yLim/y1) else kv0_effective*exp(Modelica.Math.log(1/kv0_effective)*yLim/y1);
  // pressure drop under real conditions
  dp/dp0 = medium.rho/rho0*(V_flow/Kv)*abs(V_flow/Kv);
  // no energy exchange with medium
  Q_flow = frictionLoss*V_flow*dp;
end FaultableValve;

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";

    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;

  y_actual=flowPort_a.H_flow;
  y=if faultMode==FaultMode.Bias then y_actual+faultActivation*biasFault elseif faultMode==FaultMode.GainError then y_actual*(1+faultActivation*(gainFault-1)) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.NoiseIncrease then y_actual+faultActivation*noiseAmplitude*sin(2*Modelica.Constants.pi*noiseFrequency*time) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Stuck then y_actual+faultActivation*(stuckValue-y_actual) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Dropout then y_actual*(1-faultActivation) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Saturation then y_actual+faultActivation*(min(saturationLimit,max(-saturationLimit,y_actual))-y_actual) else y_actual;

within MSLFaults.Thermal.FluidHeatFlow.Sensors;
model FaultablePressureSensor "Absolute pressure sensor"

  extends Modelica.Thermal.FluidHeatFlow.Interfaces.AbsoluteSensor(y(unit="Pa", displayUnit=
          "bar") "Absolute pressure as output signal");
  type FaultMode=enumeration(Normal "正常", Bias "偏置", GainError "增益误差", NoiseIncrease "噪声增加", Stuck "输出卡死", Dropout "输出丢失", Saturation "输出饱和");
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal;
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultStartTime=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultEndTime=3;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05;
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  parameter Real biasFault=1;
  parameter Real gainFault=0.9;
  parameter Real noiseAmplitude=0.01;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Frequency noiseFrequency=37;
  parameter Real stuckValue=0;
  parameter Real saturationLimit=1e12;
  Real y_actual;

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;

  y_actual=flowPort.p;
  y=if faultMode==FaultMode.Bias then y_actual+faultActivation*biasFault elseif faultMode==FaultMode.GainError then y_actual*(1+faultActivation*(gainFault-1)) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.NoiseIncrease then y_actual+faultActivation*noiseAmplitude*sin(2*Modelica.Constants.pi*noiseFrequency*time) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Stuck then y_actual+faultActivation*(stuckValue-y_actual) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Dropout then y_actual*(1-faultActivation) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Saturation then y_actual+faultActivation*(min(saturationLimit,max(-saturationLimit,y_actual))-y_actual) else y_actual;
end FaultablePressureSensor;

    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);

within MSLFaults.Thermal.HeatTransfer.Components;
model FaultableBodyRadiation "Lumped thermal element for radiation heat transfer"
  extends Modelica.Thermal.HeatTransfer.Interfaces.Element1D;
  parameter Real Gr(unit="m2")
    "Net radiation conductance between two surfaces (see docu)";
  type FaultMode=enumeration(Normal "正常", EmissivityDrift "辐射系数漂移", SurfaceContamination "表面污染", RadiationLoss "辐射能力下降", RadiationShort "辐射耦合增强");
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal;
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultStartTime=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultEndTime=3;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05;
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  parameter Real GrFault(unit="m2")=0.5*Gr;
  parameter Real GrShort(unit="m2")=1000*Gr;
  Real Gr_effective(unit="m2");

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  Gr_effective=if faultMode==FaultMode.EmissivityDrift or faultMode==FaultMode.SurfaceContamination then Gr+faultActivation*(GrFault-Gr) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.RadiationLoss then Gr*(1-faultActivation) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.RadiationShort then Gr+faultActivation*(GrShort-Gr) else Gr;
  Q_flow=Gr_effective*Modelica.Constants.sigma*(port_a.T^4-port_b.T^4);
end FaultableBodyRadiation;

实现与使用契约：阅读本元件源码Implementation and usage contract: inspect the source
within MSLFaults.Thermal.HeatTransfer.Components;
model FaultableConvection
  "Lumped thermal element for heat convection (Q_flow = Gc*dT)"
  Modelica.Units.SI.HeatFlowRate Q_flow "Heat flow rate from solid -> fluid";
  Modelica.Units.SI.TemperatureDifference dT "= solid.T - fluid.T";
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.RealInput Gc(unit="W/K")
    "Signal representing the convective thermal conductance in [W/K]"
  Modelica.Thermal.HeatTransfer.Interfaces.HeatPort_a solid ;
  Modelica.Thermal.HeatTransfer.Interfaces.HeatPort_b fluid ;
  type FaultMode=enumeration(Normal "正常", ConductanceDrift "对流热导漂移", Fouling "污垢降低换热", FlowLoss "流动丢失", Blockage "换热阻塞");
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal;
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultStartTime=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultEndTime=3;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05;
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  parameter Real conductanceScaleFault(min=0)=0.5;
  Real Gc_effective(unit="W/K");

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  dT = solid.T - fluid.T;
  solid.Q_flow = Q_flow;
  fluid.Q_flow = -Q_flow;
  Gc_effective=if faultMode==FaultMode.ConductanceDrift or faultMode==FaultMode.Fouling or faultMode==FaultMode.FlowLoss then Gc*(1+faultActivation*(conductanceScaleFault-1)) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Blockage then Gc*(1-faultActivation) else Gc;
  Q_flow=Gc_effective*dT;

  assert(Gc_effective>=0,"Passive heat transfer requires nonnegative conductance.");
end FaultableConvection;

  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal;
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultStartTime=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultEndTime=3;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05;
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.TemperatureDifference biasFault=1;
  parameter Real gainFault=0.9;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Temperature stuckTemperature=293.15;
  Modelica.Units.SI.Temperature temperatureActual;

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  temperatureActual=heatPort.T;
  y=if faultMode==FaultMode.TemperatureBias then temperatureActual+faultActivation*biasFault elseif faultMode==FaultMode.TemperatureGainError then temperatureActual*(1+faultActivation*(gainFault-1)) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.TemperatureStuck then temperatureActual+faultActivation*(stuckTemperature-temperatureActual) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.TemperatureDropout then temperatureActual*(1-faultActivation) else temperatureActual;
  u = heatPort.Q_flow "input = flow = heat flow";
end FaultableGeneralHeatFlowToTemperatureAdaptor;

within MSLFaults.Thermal.HeatTransfer.Components;
model FaultableHeatCapacitor "Lumped thermal element storing heat"
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.HeatCapacity C
    "Heat capacity of element (= cp*m)";
  Modelica.Units.SI.Temperature T(start=293.15, displayUnit="degC")
    "Temperature of element";
  Modelica.Units.SI.TemperatureSlope der_T(start=0)
    "Time derivative of temperature (= der(T))";
  Modelica.Thermal.HeatTransfer.Interfaces.HeatPort_a port ;
  type FaultMode=enumeration(Normal "正常", CapacityDrift "热容漂移", CapacityLoss "热容下降", ThermalRunaway "热失控", SensorLag "等效热惯性增加");
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal;
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultStartTime=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultEndTime=3;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05;
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.HeatCapacity CFault=0.5*C;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.HeatCapacity CRunaway=1e-6;
  Modelica.Units.SI.HeatCapacity C_effective;

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";
  final parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Temperature T_energyReference=0 "Fixed energy datum in kelvin";
  Modelica.Units.SI.Energy storedEnergy;
  Modelica.Units.SI.Power lossPower,parameterPower;
protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
initial equation
  assert(C>0 and CFault>0 and CRunaway>0,"Heat-capacity endpoints must remain positive.");
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  T = port.T;
  der_T = der(T);
  C_effective=if faultMode==FaultMode.CapacityDrift or faultMode==FaultMode.CapacityLoss then C+faultActivation*(CFault-C) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.ThermalRunaway then C+faultActivation*(CRunaway-C) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.SensorLag then C*(1+10*faultActivation) else C;
  der(storedEnergy)=port.Q_flow;

  storedEnergy=C_effective*(T-T_energyReference);
  lossPower=0;
  parameterPower=der(storedEnergy)-port.Q_flow;
end FaultableHeatCapacitor;

  "Lumped thermal element transporting heat without storing it"
  extends Modelica.Thermal.HeatTransfer.Interfaces.Element1D;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.ThermalConductance G
    "Constant thermal conductance of material";

  type FaultMode=enumeration(Normal "正常", ConductanceDrift "热导漂移", ConductanceLoss "热导下降", ThermalOpen "热开路", ThermalShort "热短路");

  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultEndTime=3;

  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.ThermalConductance GFault=0.5*G;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.ThermalConductance GOpen=1e-9;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.ThermalConductance GShort=1e9;
  Modelica.Units.SI.ThermalConductance G_effective;

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;
  G_effective=if faultMode==FaultMode.ConductanceDrift or faultMode==FaultMode.ConductanceLoss then G+faultActivation*(GFault-G) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.ThermalOpen then G+faultActivation*(GOpen-G) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.ThermalShort then G+faultActivation*(GShort-G) else G;
  Q_flow=G_effective*dT;

  assert(G_effective>=0,"Passive heat transfer requires nonnegative conductance.");

model FaultableHeatFlowSensor "Heat flow rate sensor"
  extends Modelica.Icons.RoundSensor;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.RealOutput Q_flow(unit="W")
    "Heat flow from port_a to port_b as output signal" ;
  Modelica.Thermal.HeatTransfer.Interfaces.HeatPort_a port_a ;
  Modelica.Thermal.HeatTransfer.Interfaces.HeatPort_b port_b ;
  type FaultMode=enumeration(Normal "正常", Bias "偏置", GainError "增益误差", NoiseIncrease "噪声增加", Stuck "输出卡死", Dropout "输出丢失", Saturation "输出饱和");
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal;
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultStartTime=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultEndTime=3;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05;
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  parameter Real biasFault=1;
  parameter Real gainFault=0.9;
  parameter Real noiseAmplitude=0.01;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Frequency noiseFrequency=37;
  parameter Real stuckValue=0;
  parameter Real saturationLimit=1e9;
  Real Q_flow_actual;

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;

  port_a.T = port_b.T;
  port_a.Q_flow + port_b.Q_flow = 0;
  Q_flow_actual=port_a.Q_flow;
  Q_flow=if faultMode==FaultMode.Bias then Q_flow_actual+faultActivation*biasFault elseif faultMode==FaultMode.GainError then Q_flow_actual*(1+faultActivation*(gainFault-1)) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.NoiseIncrease then Q_flow_actual+faultActivation*noiseAmplitude*sin(2*Modelica.Constants.pi*noiseFrequency*time) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Stuck then Q_flow_actual+faultActivation*(stuckValue-Q_flow_actual) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Dropout then Q_flow_actual*(1-faultActivation) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Saturation then Q_flow_actual+faultActivation*(min(saturationLimit,max(-saturationLimit,Q_flow_actual))-Q_flow_actual) else Q_flow_actual;
end FaultableHeatFlowSensor;

  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.RealOutput T_rel(unit="K", displayUnit="K")
    "Relative temperature as output signal"
  type FaultMode=enumeration(Normal "正常", Bias "偏置", GainError "增益误差", NoiseIncrease "噪声增加", Stuck "输出卡死", Dropout "输出丢失", Saturation "输出饱和");
  parameter FaultMode faultMode=FaultMode.Normal;
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultStartTime=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time faultEndTime=3;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05;
  Real faultActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real startActivation(min=0,max=1);
  Real endActivation(min=0,max=1);
  parameter Real biasFault=1;
  parameter Real gainFault=0.9;
  parameter Real noiseAmplitude=0.01;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Frequency noiseFrequency=37;
  parameter Real stuckValue=0;
  parameter Real saturationLimit=1e9;
  Real T_rel_actual;

public
  parameter Boolean enabled=true "Enable the selected fault mode";
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false "Use trigger instead of the internal time window" ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput trigger if useExternalTrigger
  output Boolean active "Requested or latched fault";
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1) "Current realized fault effect";
  output Integer activationCount "Number of rising activations";

protected
  MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.Activation faultGate(enabled=enabled and faultMode<>FaultMode.Normal,
    permanent=false,severity=severity,startTime=faultStartTime,endTime=faultEndTime,
    transitionTime=transitionTime,useExternalTrigger=useExternalTrigger);
equation
  connect(trigger,faultGate.externalTrigger);
  if not useExternalTrigger then faultGate.externalTrigger=false; end if;
  active=faultGate.active;
  effectLevel=faultGate.effectLevel;
  activationCount=faultGate.activationCount;

  startActivation=if severity>0 then effectLevel/severity else 0;
  endActivation=if active or effectLevel>0 then 1 else 0;
  faultActivation=effectLevel;

  T_rel_actual=port_a.T-port_b.T;
  T_rel=if faultMode==FaultMode.Bias then T_rel_actual+faultActivation*biasFault elseif faultMode==FaultMode.GainError then T_rel_actual*(1+faultActivation*(gainFault-1)) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.NoiseIncrease then T_rel_actual+faultActivation*noiseAmplitude*sin(2*Modelica.Constants.pi*noiseFrequency*time) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Stuck then T_rel_actual+faultActivation*(stuckValue-T_rel_actual) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Dropout then T_rel_actual*(1-faultActivation) elseif faultMode==FaultMode.Saturation then T_rel_actual+faultActivation*(min(saturationLimit,max(-saturationLimit,T_rel_actual))-T_rel_actual) else T_rel_actual;
  0 = port_a.Q_flow;
  0 = port_b.Q_flow;
end FaultableRelTemperatureSensor;

全部案例逐个学习Learn every example step by step

每个案例都按“问题—模型装配—参数—运行—观察—解释—改动练习”阅读。以下效果是源码可支持的预期，不是新的仿真测量；请保留实际工具的日志与曲线作为自己的复现证据。Read every example as question, assembly, parameters, execution, observation, interpretation and a controlled variation. The effects below are source-supported expectations, not new simulation measurements. Preserve your own tool logs and traces as reproduction evidence.

EXAMPLE 01

CapacitorDegradation
容量下降与 RC 充电Capacitance loss and RC charging

研究问题Question

容量下降怎样影响充电速度，运行中变容又该怎样解释？How does capacitance loss affect charging, and how should a change during operation be interpreted?

如何实现How it is assembled

三套相同 RC 回路比较原生、Normal 和 CapacitanceLoss。dynamicLoss=false 时从初始即故障；true 时在 1 s 后用 0.2 s 过渡改变容量。Three identical RC circuits compare native, Normal and CapacitanceLoss. With dynamicLoss=false the fault is present initially; true introduces it after 1 s through a 0.2 s transition.

应当观察到什么What to look for

默认故障降低容量，因此相同电阻和供电下充电更快。动态变容时应同时检查电压、电荷和储能，不能只把变容造成的功率项当成热损耗。Reduced capacitance charges more rapidly with the same resistance and supply. During a dynamic change inspect voltage, charge and stored energy; power associated with changing capacitance is not automatically heat loss.

自己动手修改Controlled variation

先保持 dynamicLoss=false 对照时间常数，再打开 dynamicLoss 并比较过渡区。Compare time constants with dynamicLoss=false, then enable dynamicLoss and inspect the transition.

能够得出的结论与边界Interpretation and limits

模型中的容量损失是假设的等效机理；真实损伤过程需要额外物理依据。Capacitance loss is an assumed equivalent mechanism; a real damage process requires additional physical justification.

重点观察变量Variables to inspect

nativeValuenormalValuefaultedValue

源码声明的实验设置：Declared experiment settings: StartTime=0 · StopTime=5 · Interval=0.01 · Tolerance=1e-6

装配组件及明确设置的参数Instantiated components and explicit parameter settings
MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.CapacitorCircuit native;
MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.CapacitorCircuit normal(redeclare MSLFaults.Electrical.Analog.Basic.FaultableCapacitor device);
MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.CapacitorCircuit faulted(redeclare MSLFaults.Electrical.Analog.Basic.FaultableCapacitor device(faultMode=mode,faultStartTime=if dynamicLoss then 1 else 0,faultEndTime=6,transitionTime=if dynamicLoss then 0.2 else 0));
parameter Boolean dynamicLoss=false "Ramp the capacity loss during the run";
parameter MSLFaults.Electrical.Analog.Basic.FaultableCapacitor.FaultMode mode=MSLFaults.Electrical.Analog.Basic.FaultableCapacitor.FaultMode.CapacitanceLoss;
实际 connect 连线Actual connect statements
connect(native.readout,nativeValue);
connect(normal.readout,normalValue);
connect(faulted.readout,faultedValue);
本案例复现脚本Reproduction script for this example
loadModel(Modelica, {"4.0.0"});
loadFile("package.mo");
checkModel(MSLFaults.Examples.CapacitorDegradation);
simulate(MSLFaults.Examples.CapacitorDegradation,
  startTime=0, stopTime=5,
  numberOfIntervals=1000, tolerance=1e-6);
getErrorString();

EXAMPLE 02

ElectromechanicalFaultEffects
电机多域响应与独立电磁转换Multi-domain motor response and a separate magnetic converter

研究问题Question

同一故障怎样在电流、运动和热量上体现？How does one fault appear in current, motion and temperature?

如何实现How it is assembled

configuration=0/1/2/3 选择正常、绕组电阻、反馈增益或组合故障；另一组独立磁路比较有效匝数损失，dynamicTurns 可在运行中平滑改变匝数。configuration=0/1/2/3 selects nominal, winding resistance, feedback gain or combined faults. A separate magnetic-circuit group compares effective-turn loss; dynamicTurns permits a smooth change during operation.

应当观察到什么What to look for

依次比较电流、转速与温度，不假设电阻增加必然使每项量都同方向变化。磁路对照中的电流与磁通反映转换器参数变化，但该磁路不是电机支路内部磁场。Compare current, speed and temperature in sequence without assuming that increased resistance changes every quantity in the same direction. The magnetic comparison reflects converter variation but is not the internal field of the motor branch.

自己动手修改Controlled variation

依次运行 configuration 0、1、2、3，形成单因素与组合对照；另行切换 dynamicTurns。Run configurations 0, 1, 2 and 3 for single-factor and combined comparisons, then vary dynamicTurns in a separate study.

能够得出的结论与边界Interpretation and limits

组合效应一般不能由两个单独差值简单相加，也不能把独立子实验误读成完整电机电磁联合仿真。Combined effects are not generally the sum of separate differences; independent sub-experiments are not a fully coupled electromagnetic motor simulation.

重点观察变量Variables to inspect

motorNativeCurrentmotorFaultCurrentmotorNativeSpeedmotorFaultSpeedmotorNativeTemperaturemotorFaultTemperaturefluxNativeFluxfluxFaultFlux

源码声明的实验设置：Declared experiment settings: StartTime=0 · StopTime=8 · Interval=0.01 · Tolerance=1e-6

装配组件及明确设置的参数Instantiated components and explicit parameter settings
MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.ElectromechanicalCircuit motorNative;
MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.ElectromechanicalCircuit motorFault(redeclare MSLFaults.Electrical.Analog.Basic.FaultableResistor winding(faultMode=if configuration==1 or configuration==3 then MSLFaults.Electrical.Analog.Basic.FaultableResistor.FaultMode.ResistanceStep else MSLFaults.Electrical.Analog.Basic.FaultableResistor.FaultMode.Normal,R_step=4,faultEndTime=6),redeclare MSLFaults.Blocks.Math.FaultableGain feedback(faultMode=if configuration==2 or configuration==3 then MSLFaults.Blocks.Math.FaultableGain.FaultMode.GainDrift else MSLFaults.Blocks.Math.FaultableGain.FaultMode.Normal,kFault=0.05,faultEndTime=6));
MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.ElectromagneticCircuit fluxNative;
MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.ElectromagneticCircuit fluxNormal(redeclare MSLFaults.Magnetic.FluxTubes.Basic.FaultableElectroMagneticConverter converter);
MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal.ElectromagneticCircuit fluxFault(redeclare MSLFaults.Magnetic.FluxTubes.Basic.FaultableElectroMagneticConverter converter(faultMode=MSLFaults.Magnetic.FluxTubes.Basic.FaultableElectroMagneticConverter.FaultMode.TurnLoss,NFault=50,faultStartTime=if dynamicTurns then 1 else 0,faultEndTime=9,transitionTime=if dynamicTurns then 0.3 else 0));
parameter Integer configuration(min=0,max=3)=1 "0 Normal, 1 resistance, 2 feedback gain, 3 combined";
parameter Boolean dynamicTurns=false "Ramp the converter turns after initialization";

EXAMPLE 03

FluidValveDegradation
阀能力下降与压力测量偏置Valve degradation and pressure-sensing bias

研究问题Question

阀机理故障和传感偏置分别影响什么？What changes under valve degradation versus sensing bias?

如何实现How it is assembled

三个独立流路比较原生、Normal 与故障阀和压力传感器；执行器增益为 0.5，传感器偏置 1000 Pa。reverseFlow 与 freezeCommand 可切换额外实验条件。Three independent flow paths compare native, Normal and faulted valves and pressure sensors. Actuator gain is 0.5 and sensing bias 1000 Pa. reverseFlow and freezeCommand select additional configurations.

应当观察到什么What to look for

默认恒压差工况下故障阀流量减小，压力读数增加 1000 Pa；反向设置改变有符号流量。冻结开度实验需要检查激活沿捕获值，而非把 FreezeOpening 理解为固定零开度。Under the default fixed pressure difference, faulted valve flow decreases and pressure reporting increases by 1000 Pa. Reverse flow changes signed flow. FreezeOpening captures its activation-edge opening rather than necessarily forcing zero.

自己动手修改Controlled variation

先只切换 reverseFlow，再恢复默认并打开 freezeCommand；不要同时改变介质与边界。First change reverseFlow only; then restore defaults and enable freezeCommand, keeping medium and boundaries unchanged.

能够得出的结论与边界Interpretation and limits

传感器偏置不等于真实容腔压力上升，固定压力边界也不能代表任意供流网络。Sensor bias is not a physical pressure rise, and fixed-pressure boundaries do not represent every flow network.

EXAMPLE 04

InductorDegradation
电感下降与 RL 电流Inductance loss and RL current

研究问题Question

较小电感为什么改变暂态而不必改变最终直流电流？Why can reduced inductance change the transient without changing final DC current?

如何实现How it is assembled

三套回路只在电感实现与故障设置上不同，故障从初始化生效，电源与电阻保持相同。Three circuits differ only in inductor implementation and fault configuration. The fault is active initially while source and resistance remain unchanged.

应当观察到什么What to look for

故障电流建立更快；稳定直流电流仍由供电和电阻决定。对照 nativeValue 与 normalValue，并检查故障支路初期变化速率。The faulted current establishes more rapidly, while steady DC current is determined by supply and resistance. Compare nativeValue with normalValue and inspect the early faulted slope.

自己动手修改Controlled variation

在独立副本中改变故障后的电感或激活时刻，比较磁链连续性与电流响应。In a separate copy, vary the faulted inductance or activation time and compare flux-linkage continuity and current response.

能够得出的结论与边界Interpretation and limits

带电状态下的参数突变与从初始使用较小电感不是同一个实验。Changing inductance while energised is not the same experiment as starting with a smaller inductance.

EXAMPLE 05

MagneticReluctance
磁阻增加与磁通Reluctance increase and magnetic flux

研究问题Question

固定磁势下的磁阻变化能否直接做数量级核对？Can reluctance variation under fixed magnetomotive force be checked analytically?

如何实现How it is assembled

100 A·turn 磁势驱动原生、Normal 和故障磁阻支路；名义磁阻 1000，故障值 2000。A 100 ampere-turn source drives native, Normal and faulted reluctance branches. Nominal reluctance is 1000 and the fault value 2000.

应当观察到什么What to look for

按磁通=磁势/磁阻，名义磁通应为 0.1 Wb，故障为 0.05 Wb。Normal 应保持名义对照。Using flux=magnetomotive force/reluctance, nominal flux should be 0.1 Wb and faulted flux 0.05 Wb. Normal should match the nominal counterpart.

自己动手修改Controlled variation

将 R_mFault 改为 4000，核对磁通是否约为 0.025 Wb。Set R_mFault to 4000 and check for approximately 0.025 Wb.

能够得出的结论与边界Interpretation and limits

线性集总磁路的比较不代表已经考虑材料饱和、空间漏磁或温度耦合。A linear lumped comparison does not establish material saturation, spatial leakage or temperature coupling.

EXAMPLE 06

ResistorReplacement
电阻与电导的三支路比较Three-way resistor and conductor comparison

研究问题Question

故障替换是否保留名义行为，并在指定时段产生可恢复变化？Does replacement preserve nominal behaviour and produce the scheduled reversible change?

如何实现How it is assembled

原生、Normal、故障电阻各构成独立 12 V 回路；R 从 10 变到 20 Ω。电导对照从 0.1 变到 0.05 S。Native, Normal and faulted resistors form separate 12 V circuits; R changes from 10 to 20 ohms. The corresponding conductance changes from 0.1 to 0.05 S.

应当观察到什么What to look for

名义电流为 1.2 A，故障平台为 0.6 A。默认故障请求从 1 到 3 s，0.05 s 过渡使平台和恢复需要有限时间；比较 native 与 normal 是否重合。Nominal current is 1.2 A and the fault plateau 0.6 A. The default request spans 1–3 s with a 0.05 s transition, so the plateau and recovery take finite time. Compare native and Normal traces.

自己动手修改Controlled variation

只改变 R_step 或 faultStartTime，分别观察故障幅值和发生时刻。Change R_step or faultStartTime separately to examine magnitude and timing.

能够得出的结论与边界Interpretation and limits

这是固定理想电压源边界下的机制比较，不是所有供电拓扑的验证。This is a mechanism comparison under a fixed ideal voltage boundary, not validation of every supply topology.

EXAMPLE 07

RotationalDamping
阻尼、惯量与弹簧的不同后果Different consequences of damping, inertia and stiffness

研究问题Question

哪些故障改变转速平台，哪些主要改变响应速度？Which faults change the speed plateau and which primarily change response speed?

如何实现How it is assembled

1 N·m 恒转矩驱动 J=0.1、d=0.1 的转动支路。独立故障支路增大阻尼或把惯量改为 0.05；另有同角位移输入的弹簧对照，故障刚度为 5。A constant 1 N m drives a branch with J=0.1 and d=0.1. Independent branches increase damping or reduce inertia to 0.05. A separate spring comparison uses the same imposed angle and fault stiffness 5.

应当观察到什么What to look for

名义速度趋近 10 rad/s。增加阻尼降低速度平台；减小惯量加快响应但不改变由转矩/阻尼决定的平台。规定相同角位移时，较软弹簧产生较小转矩。Nominal speed tends towards 10 rad/s. Increased damping lowers the plateau; reduced inertia accelerates response without changing the torque/damping plateau. A softer spring produces less torque for the same imposed angle.

自己动手修改Controlled variation

比较各支路最终值与到达平台的速度，再分别修改 JFault 和 dIncrease。Compare final values and approach rates, then vary JFault and dIncrease independently.

能够得出的结论与边界Interpretation and limits

弹簧支路与驱动支路是独立实验，不能把它们误读成同一传动链。The spring and drive branches are separate experiments, not one transmission chain.

EXAMPLE 08

SensorAndSignalFaults
冻结、固定值与测量偏置Freezing, fixed values and measurement bias

研究问题Question

读数异常是否意味着本体物理量也改变？Does an abnormal reading mean the physical quantity changed?

如何实现How it is assembled

公共斜坡驱动信号与电气测量对照。故障窗口为 [1,2) s；增益和一阶环节冻结，限幅器输出固定 0.25，电流读数卡住，电压读数叠加 1 V。A common ramp drives signal and electrical-sensing comparisons. Over [1,2) s, gain and first-order paths freeze, the limiter fixes output at 0.25, current sensing sticks and voltage sensing adds 1 V.

应当观察到什么What to look for

名义与 Normal 路径应一致；冻结/卡住读数在窗口内不再跟随原输入，电压读数偏移。电路真实电流并不会因为读数保持就自动停止变化。Native and Normal paths should agree. Held readings stop tracking their original input and voltage reporting shifts. Physical circuit current does not automatically stop changing because a reading is held.

自己动手修改Controlled variation

延长故障窗，再比较解除时的读数恢复与动态环节内部状态恢复。Extend the fault window and compare recovery of reported values with recovery of dynamic internal states.

能够得出的结论与边界Interpretation and limits

该案例没有把所有故障读数反馈到一个控制器，不能直接当作闭环稳定性结论。Not all faulted readings are fed back to a controller here; this is not a closed-loop stability conclusion.

EXAMPLE 09

ThermalDegradation
传热下降与热容下降Reduced heat transfer versus reduced thermal capacity

研究问题Question

为何一种故障提高最终温度，另一种只加快升温？Why can one fault raise final temperature while another mainly accelerates heating?

如何实现How it is assembled

相同热源和环境下比较热导、热容和对流变化。故障热导为 5、故障热容为 50，对流系数缩放为 0.5，各故障从初始化激活。With the same heat source and environment, separate branches vary conductance, heat capacity and convection. Fault conductance is 5, capacity 50 and convection scale 0.5, all active initially.

应当观察到什么What to look for

传热能力降低会增大相同持续热负荷下的温差；热容量减小主要缩短时间常数。导热与对流的同等有效热导变化应产生可比较的温度趋势。Reduced transfer increases the temperature difference needed to reject the same sustained heat load. Reduced heat capacity primarily shortens the time constant. Equivalent changes in effective conductive and convective transfer should produce comparable trends.

自己动手修改Controlled variation

保持热源不变，分别改变 GFault、CFault 和 conductanceScaleFault，比较平台与上升速度。Keep the heat source fixed and vary GFault, CFault and conductanceScaleFault separately, comparing plateaux and rise rates.

能够得出的结论与边界Interpretation and limits

温度曲线不能单独推断实际材料损坏；仍需允许温度和暴露时长的独立判据。A temperature trace alone does not establish material damage; allowable temperature and exposure criteria remain separate.

重点观察变量Variables to inspect

nativeTemperaturenormalTemperatureconductanceFaultTemperaturecapacityFaultTemperaturenativeConvectionTemperaturenormalConvectionTemperaturefaultConvectionTemperature

源码声明的实验设置：Declared experiment settings: StartTime=0 · StopTime=60 · Interval=0.01 · Tolerance=1e-6

装配组件及明确设置的参数Instantiated components and explicit parameter settings

EXAMPLE 10

TranslationalStiffness
质量—弹簧—阻尼的参数辨别Distinguishing mass, stiffness and damping effects

研究问题Question

怎样从静态位移与动态振荡区分三类故障？How can static displacement and transient oscillation distinguish three fault types?

如何实现How it is assembled

1 N 恒力驱动 m=1、c=100、d=2 的支路；分别比较刚度下降到 50、质量下降到 0.5 和阻尼增加。A constant 1 N drives m=1, c=100 and d=2. Separate branches reduce stiffness to 50, reduce mass to 0.5 or increase damping.

应当观察到什么What to look for

名义静态位移为 0.01 m，刚度减半后为 0.02 m；质量与阻尼变化主要改变振荡和衰减过程，在相同刚度下不改变静态力平衡位移。Nominal static displacement is 0.01 m and becomes 0.02 m when stiffness halves. Mass and damping primarily alter oscillation and decay; with unchanged stiffness they do not change static force-balance displacement.

自己动手修改Controlled variation

先比较静态位置，再比较峰值和振荡周期，不要只用最后一个时刻评价故障影响。Compare static position first, then peaks and oscillation period rather than judging the fault from the final sample alone.

能够得出的结论与边界Interpretation and limits

有限仿真终点未必已经达到静态；应检查残余振荡。A finite simulation end is not necessarily steady state; inspect residual oscillation.

重点观察变量Variables to inspect

nativePositionnormalPositionstiffnessFaultPositionmassFaultPositiondampingFaultPosition

07

从案例迁移到自己的科研实验Move from examples to your own research experiment

从一个已经能正常运行的本体开始，选一个元件建立三套副本：原生、故障版本 Normal、故障激活。除元件实现与目标故障参数外，其余边界和初值保持一致。先把名义差异解释清楚，再研究故障后果。Begin with a working nominal host and create three copies: native, fault-capable Normal and activated fault. Keep boundaries and initial conditions identical except for implementation and target fault parameters. Explain nominal discrepancies before interpreting fault consequences.

下方教学模型直接实例化可故障电阻。对于现有 replaceable 工程，应参考库内例子的 redeclare 写法并检查类型约束，不要把文件名替换当成完成语义替换。The teaching model below directly instantiates a fault-capable resistor. In an existing replaceable design, follow the examples’ redeclare pattern and check type constraints; replacing a filename is not a semantic replacement.

within;
model MyResistorStudy
  Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Sources.ConstantVoltage supply(V=12);
  Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Basic.Ground ground;
  MSLFaults.Electrical.Analog.Basic.FaultableResistor device(
    R=10,
    faultMode=MSLFaults.Electrical.Analog.Basic.FaultableResistor.FaultMode.ResistanceStep,
    R_step=20, faultStartTime=1, faultEndTime=3, transitionTime=0.05);
equation
  connect(supply.p, device.p);
  connect(device.n, supply.n);
  connect(supply.n, ground.p);
  annotation(experiment(StopTime=5, Tolerance=1e-6));
end MyResistorStudy;
上述片段是教学实验模板，不替代目标工具的翻译检查。保存为单独文件并在已加载本库后打开；不要直接覆盖库内的正式模型。The snippet is a teaching experiment template, not a substitute for translation checks in the intended tool. Save it separately and load it after this library; do not overwrite distributed models.
必须记录Record记录方法How to record it
源码与环境Source and environment本库提交号、本体提交号、MSL 版本、工具版本和运行平台。Library and host commits, MSL version, tool version and execution platform.
干预与场景Intervention and scenario参数值、初始状态、接线拓扑、输入时序、各个可选端口是否启用。Parameter values, initial states, topology, input timing and every enabled optional connector.
数值设置Numerical settings仿真起止时刻、求解器、容差、最大步长（如设置）、结果输出网格、内部采样网格。Start/stop times, solver, tolerance, maximum step where set, output grid and internal sampling grid.
结论与证据Conclusion and evidence实际曲线、关键事件时刻、无效与不完整状态、与预期不符的内容。Actual traces, event times, invalid/incomplete states and discrepancies from the expected behaviour.
08

排错、适用边界与常见误读Troubleshooting, scope and common misinterpretations

Normal 与原生不重合Normal differs from the native component

先核对所有名义参数、初态、条件热端口和边界。某些替换使用正则化或有限失效参数；先阅读该类实现，再判断是否存在需要报告的问题。Check nominal parameters, initial states, conditional thermal ports and boundaries. Some replacements use regularisation or finite failure parameters; inspect the implementation before diagnosing a discrepancy.

某个 FaultMode 无法选择A FaultMode cannot be selected

枚举来自具体类，不是库级通用 FaultMode。复制其他元件的枚举路径会产生类型错误；以本卡列出的实际成员为准。The enumeration belongs to a specific class, not a universal library type. Copying another component’s enumeration path causes a type mismatch; use the declared members.

恢复后曲线没有回到原位置Recovery does not restore the original trajectory

状态量已经积累了不同的电荷、磁链、速度、位移或热量。恢复参数只恢复关系，不会自动重置整个系统历史。Charge, flux linkage, speed, displacement or heat may have evolved differently. Restoring a parameter restores a relation, not the complete system history.

可以说该库覆盖了所有故障吗Does the library cover all failures?

不能。覆盖范围是源码实际声明的模式与建模假设；目录验证标签也不能替代具体模式、工况、工具和参数范围的运行证据。No. Coverage is limited to declared modes and modelling assumptions. Catalogue labels do not replace execution evidence for a particular mode, condition, tool and parameter range.

报错时先定位最小问题：加载失败、模型不平衡、初始化冲突、积分失败、输出不符合预期，是不同层次的问题。提交 issue 时给出最小模型、参数、工具版本、完整诊断和预期结果。不要用放宽容差掩盖接线或物理定义错误。Separate loading failures, structural imbalance, initialisation conflicts, integration failures and unexpected outputs. An issue should include a minimal model, parameters, tool version, complete diagnostics and expected behaviour. Do not use looser tolerances to conceal topology or physical-definition errors.

实现与使用契约：阅读本元件源码Implementation and usage contract: inspect the source
within MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal;
block Activation "Reversible ramp and optional permanent activation latch"
parameter Boolean enabled=true;
  parameter Boolean permanent=false;
  parameter Real severity(min=0,max=1)=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time startTime=1;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time endTime=3;
  parameter Modelica.Units.SI.Time transitionTime(min=0)=0.05;
  parameter Boolean useExternalTrigger=false;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.BooleanInput externalTrigger ;
  output Boolean active;
  output Modelica.Units.SI.Time elapsedActiveTime;
  output Real effectLevel(min=0,max=1);
  output Integer activationCount(start=0,fixed=true);
protected
  Boolean request;
  discrete Boolean latched(start=false,fixed=true);
  discrete Real fromLevel(start=0,fixed=true);
  discrete Modelica.Units.SI.Time edgeTime(start=0,fixed=true);
  Real level;
  discrete Modelica.Units.SI.Time endedDuration(start=0,fixed=true);
initial equation
  assert(severity>=0 and severity<=1,"Severity outside [0,1].");
  assert(endTime>=startTime,"End time precedes start time.");
  assert(transitionTime>=0,"Negative transition duration.");
equation
  request=enabled and severity>0 and (if useExternalTrigger then externalTrigger else time>=startTime and time<endTime);
  when {initial(),request} then
    latched=(if initial() then false else pre(latched)) or (permanent and request);
  end when;
  active=request or latched;
  when {initial(),change(active)} then
    fromLevel=if initial() or transitionTime<=0 then 0 else
      min(1,max(0,pre(fromLevel)+(if pre(active) then 1 else -1)*(time-pre(edgeTime))/transitionTime));
    edgeTime=time;
    endedDuration=if initial() or active then 0 else time-pre(edgeTime);
    activationCount=(if initial() then 0 else pre(activationCount))+(if active then 1 else 0);
  end when;
  level=if transitionTime<=0 then (if active then 1 else 0) else
    min(1,max(0,fromLevel+(if active then 1 else -1)*(time-edgeTime)/transitionTime));
  elapsedActiveTime=if active then time-edgeTime else endedDuration;
  effectLevel=severity*level;
end Activation;

  Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Sources.StepVoltage source(V=12,startTime=0.1) ;
  Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Basic.Resistor series(R=10) ;
  Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Basic.Ground electricalGround ;
  replaceable Modelica.Magnetic.FluxTubes.Basic.ElectroMagneticConverter converter  constrainedby Modelica.Magnetic.FluxTubes.Basic.ElectroMagneticConverter(N=100,i(start=0,fixed=true));
  Modelica.Magnetic.FluxTubes.Basic.ConstantReluctance load(R_m=1000) ;
  Modelica.Magnetic.FluxTubes.Basic.Ground magneticGround ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Sources.RealExpression currentView(y=converter.i) ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.RealOutput current ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Sources.RealExpression fluxView(y=load.Phi) ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.RealOutput flux ;
equation
  connect(source.p,series.p) ;
  connect(series.n,converter.p) ;
  connect(source.n,electricalGround.p) ;
  connect(converter.n,electricalGround.p) ;
  connect(converter.port_p,load.port_p) ;
  connect(load.port_n,magneticGround.port) ;
  connect(converter.port_n,magneticGround.port) ;
  connect(currentView.y,current) ;
  connect(fluxView.y,flux) ;
end ElectromagneticCircuit;

实现与使用契约：阅读本元件源码Implementation and usage contract: inspect the source
within MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal;
model ElectromechanicalCircuit "Drive a motor and heated winding with speed feedback"
  parameter Real resistance=2;
  Modelica.Blocks.Sources.RealExpression voltageCommand(y=12-feedback.y) ;
  Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Sources.SignalVoltage source ;
  Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Basic.Ground electricalGround ;
  replaceable Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Basic.Resistor winding  constrainedby Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Basic.Resistor(R=resistance,useHeatPort=true);
  Modelica.Electrical.Analog.Basic.RotationalEMF motor(k=0.2) ;
  Modelica.Mechanics.Rotational.Components.Inertia rotor(J=0.1,w(start=0,fixed=true),phi(start=0,fixed=true)) ;
  Modelica.Mechanics.Rotational.Components.Damper friction(d=0.1) ;
  Modelica.Mechanics.Rotational.Components.Fixed reference ;
  Modelica.Mechanics.Rotational.Sensors.SpeedSensor speedSensor ;
  replaceable Modelica.Blocks.Math.Gain feedback  constrainedby Modelica.Blocks.Math.Gain(k=0.1);
  Modelica.Thermal.HeatTransfer.Components.HeatCapacitor windingHeat(C=100,T(start=300,fixed=true)) ;
  Modelica.Thermal.HeatTransfer.Components.ThermalConductor cooling(G=1) ;
  Modelica.Thermal.HeatTransfer.Sources.FixedTemperature ambient(T=300) ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Sources.RealExpression currentView(y=winding.i) ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.RealOutput current ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.RealOutput speed ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Sources.RealExpression temperatureView(y=windingHeat.T) ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.RealOutput temperature ;
equation
  connect(voltageCommand.y,source.v) ;
  connect(source.p,winding.p) ;
  connect(source.n,electricalGround.p) ;
  connect(winding.n,motor.p) ;
  connect(motor.n,electricalGround.p) ;
  connect(motor.flange,rotor.flange_a) ;
  connect(rotor.flange_b,friction.flange_a) ;
  connect(friction.flange_b,reference.flange) ;
  connect(rotor.flange_b,speedSensor.flange) ;
  connect(speedSensor.w,feedback.u) ;
  connect(winding.heatPort,windingHeat.port) ;
  connect(windingHeat.port,cooling.port_a) ;
  connect(cooling.port_b,ambient.port) ;
  connect(currentView.y,current) ;
  connect(speedSensor.w,speed) ;
  connect(temperatureView.y,temperature) ;
end ElectromechanicalCircuit;

参数与默认声明（2 项）Parameters and declared defaults (2)
parameter Boolean reverse=false;
parameter Boolean varyOpening=false;
输入、输出和物理端口（2 项）Inputs, outputs and physical connectors (2)

实现与使用契约：阅读本元件源码Implementation and usage contract: inspect the source
within MSLFaults.Utilities.Internal;
model ValveCircuit "Compare isenthalpic two-port paths and a zero-flow pressure reading"
  replaceable package Medium=Modelica.Media.Water.ConstantPropertyLiquidWater constrainedby Modelica.Media.Interfaces.PartialMedium;
  inner Modelica.Fluid.System system;
  parameter Boolean reverse=false;
  parameter Boolean varyOpening=false;
  Modelica.Fluid.Sources.Boundary_pT upstream(redeclare package Medium=Medium,nPorts=2,p=if reverse then 1e5 else 2e5,T=306) ;
  Modelica.Fluid.Sources.Boundary_pT downstream(redeclare package Medium=Medium,nPorts=1,p=if reverse then 2e5 else 1e5,T=296) ;
  replaceable Modelica.Fluid.Valves.ValveLinear valve  constrainedby Modelica.Fluid.Valves.ValveLinear(redeclare package Medium=Medium,m_flow_nominal=1,dp_nominal=1e5);
  Modelica.Blocks.Sources.RealExpression valveCommand(y=if varyOpening then min(1,0.25+0.25*time) else 1) ;
  replaceable Modelica.Fluid.Sensors.Pressure sensor  constrainedby Modelica.Fluid.Sensors.Pressure(redeclare package Medium=Medium);
  Modelica.Blocks.Sources.RealExpression massFlowView(y=valve.m_flow) ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.RealOutput massFlow ;
  Modelica.Blocks.Interfaces.RealOutput pressure ;
equation
  connect(upstream.ports[1],valve.port_a) ;
  connect(valve.port_b,downstream.ports[1]) ;
  connect(valveCommand.y,valve.opening) ;
  connect(upstream.ports[2],sensor.port) ;
  connect(massFlowView.y,massFlow) ;
  connect(sensor.p,pressure) ;
end ValveCircuit;
